AI.conclusion: 通过模拟大脑的竞争偏向机制实现自适应模态抑制，能够有效处理多模态信号相关性不均的问题，为视觉-音频联合分割提供了新思路。

title: SpecBlock: Block-Iterative Speculative Decoding with Dynamic Tree Drafting
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by drafting a tree of candidate continuations and verifying it in one target forward. Existing drafters fall into two camps with opposite weaknesses. Autoregressive drafters such as EAGLE-3 preserve dependence along each draft path but call the drafter once per tree depth, making drafting a non-trivial share of per-iteration latency. Parallel drafters cut drafter calls by predicting multiple future positions in one forward, but each position is predicted without seeing the others, producing paths the verifier rejects. In this paper, we propose SpecBlock, a block-iterative drafter that combines path dependence with cheap drafting. Each drafter forward produces K dependent positions and we call this a block. The draft tree grows through repeated block expansions. Two mechanisms explicitly carry path dependence to keep later draft positions accurate. Within each block, a layer-wise shift carries the previous position's hidden state into every decoder layer. Across blocks, each new block can start from any position of the previous block, inheriting its hidden state to extend the path. To spend verifier budget where acceptance is likely, a co-trained rank head replaces the fixed top-k tree by allocating per-position branching during drafting. To avoid training the drafter on prefixes it never produces at inference, a valid-prefix mask drops the loss at later positions once an earlier one is wrong. Beyond static drafting, a cost-aware bandit at deployment uses free verifier feedback to update the drafter selectively, only when the expected throughput gain exceeds the update cost. Experiments show that SpecBlock improves mean speedup by 8-13% over EAGLE-3 at 44-52% of its drafting cost, and cost-aware adaptation extends this lead to 11-19%.

AI.tldr: SpecBlock是一种块迭代式草稿模型，通过在每个前向中生成K个依赖位置（块），结合层间偏移和跨块隐藏状态继承来保持路径依赖性，同时通过可训练的排序头、有效前缀掩码和成本感知的自适应机制，在降低草稿计算成本的同时提高LLM推理加速效果，相比EAGLE-3实现8-13%的平均加速提升，草稿成本仅为44-52%。
AI.motivation: 现有推测解码中的草稿模型存在两难困境：自回归草稿器（如EAGLE-3）保持路径依赖性但每次深度调用一次草稿器，导致延迟开销大；并行草稿器一次前向预测多个位置但各位置独立预测，导致验证器拒绝率高。作者旨在设计一种兼具路径依赖性和低草稿成本的草稿模型。
AI.method: SpecBlock采用三种关键技术：1）块内层间偏移（Layer-wise Shift）将前一个位置的隐藏状态传递到每个解码层；2）跨块机制允许新块从上一块的任意位置开始，继承隐藏状态扩展路径；3）联合训练的排序头替代固定top-k树，根据接受概率分配分支；4）有效前缀掩码避免训练时在错误前缀上计算损失；5）部署时使用成本感知的bandit算法，根据吞吐量增益选择性更新草稿器。
AI.result: SpecBlock在平均加速上比EAGLE-3提升8-13%，草稿成本仅为EAGLE-3的44-52%。引入成本感知的自适应机制后，加速优势进一步扩大至11-19%。
AI.conclusion: 通过块迭代设计，SpecBlock有效平衡了草稿路径依赖性和计算效率之间的矛盾，表明在推测解码中通过合理的结构设计和自适应机制可以同时实现高接受率和低草稿成本。

title: SREGym: A Live Benchmark for AI SRE Agents with High-Fidelity Failure Scenarios
summary: AI agents are increasingly used to diagnose and mitigate failures in production systems, known as agentic Site Reliability Engineering (SRE). Current SRE benchmarks are limited to oversimplistic SRE tasks and are unfortunately hard to extend due to bespoke designs. We present SREGym, a high-fidelity benchmark for SRE agents. SREGym exposes a live system environment built atop real-world cloud-native system stacks, where high-fidelity failure scenarios are simulated through fault injectors. SREGym models the complexity of production environments by simulating (1) a wide range of faults at different layers, (2) various ambient noises, and (3) diverse failure modes such as metastable failures and correlated failures. SREGym is architected as a modular, extensible framework that orchestrates fault and noise injectors across stacks. SREGym currently includes 90 realistic, challenging SRE problems. We use SREGym to evaluate frontier agents and show that their capabilities varies significantly in addressing different kinds of failures, with up to 40% differences in end-to-end results. SREGym is actively maintained as an open-source project and has been used by researchers and practitioners.

AI.tldr: SREGym是一个高保真的SRE智能体基准测试平台，基于真实云原生系统栈构建，包含90个现实SRE问题，并发现不同智能体在应对故障时性能差异可达40%。
AI.motivation: 现有SRE基准测试过于简化且难以扩展，缺乏高保真度的生产环境模拟，无法有效评估AI智能体在真实复杂场景下的运维能力。
AI.method: 基于真实云原生系统栈构建实时系统环境，通过故障注入器模拟多层故障、环境噪声及各类失效模式（如亚稳态故障、关联故障），采用模块化可扩展框架编排故障与噪声注入。
AI.result: 包含90个现实SRE问题；评估前沿智能体发现其应对不同类型故障能力差异显著，端到端结果差异高达40%。
AI.conclusion: SREGym作为开源项目已被研究人员和从业者使用，为评估和改进SRE智能体提供了高保真、可扩展的基准平台。

title: PaT: Planning-after-Trial for Efficient Test-Time Code Generation
summary: Beyond training-time optimization, scaling test-time computation has emerged as a key paradigm to extend the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, most existing methods adopt a rigid Planning-before-Trial (PbT) policy, which inefficiently allocates test-time compute by incurring planning overhead even on directly solvable problems. We propose Planning-after-Trial (PaT), an adaptive policy for code generation that invokes a planner only upon verification failure. This adaptive policy naturally enables a heterogeneous model configuration: a cost-efficient model handles generation attempts, while a powerful model is reserved for targeted planning interventions. Empirically, across multiple benchmarks and model families, our approach significantly advances the cost-performance Pareto frontier. Notably, our heterogeneous configuration achieves performance comparable to a large homogeneous model while reducing inference cost by approximately 69\%.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种自适应的测试时计算策略PaT（Planning-after-Trial），该策略仅在验证失败时才调用规划器，从而实现异构模型配置（轻量模型生成+强模型规划），在代码生成任务中显著提升了成本-性能帕累托前沿，性能与大型同构模型相当但推理成本降低约69%。
AI.motivation: 现有的Planning-before-Trial（PbT）策略对所有问题都预先进行规划，即使对可直接求解的问题也会产生不必要的规划开销，导致测试时计算资源分配低效。
AI.method: 提出Planning-after-Trial（PaT）自适应策略：先用成本高效的模型进行生成尝试，仅在验证失败后才调用规划器进行干预规划，支持异构模型配置（轻量模型生成+强模型规划）。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试和模型家族上，该方法显著推进了成本-性能帕累托前沿；异构配置在保持与大型同构模型相当性能的同时，将推理成本降低了约69%。
AI.conclusion: PaT策略通过"先试后规划"的自适应方式有效解决了测试时计算资源的低效分配问题，异构模型配置为实现高性能低成本推理提供了可行路径。

title: Masks Can Talk: Extracting Structured Text Information from Single-Modal Images for Remote Sensing Change Detection
summary: Remote sensing change detection is pivotal for urban monitoring, disaster assessment, and environmental resource management. Yet, unimodal deep learning methods frequently confuse genuine semantic changes with visually similar but irrelevant variations. Recent multimodal approaches incorporate text as auxiliary supervision, but their descriptions are either semantically coarse and unstructured or model-generated and thus noisy. Critically, all of them overlook a simple fact: fine-grained change semantics are already implicitly encoded in the ground-truth mask labels that come standard with every change detection dataset. These masks know where the change happened, what the land-cover types were before and after, how the transition occurred, and how many objects were involved. In this paper, we propose S2M, a framework that obtains structured textual features directly from change labels at zero additional annotation cost. Specifically, each change region is automatically transcribed into a semantic quadruple (where, what, how, how many) and converted into several fixed-template text descriptions, providing precise, dense, and noise-free multimodal supervision. We adopts a two-stage training strategy to fine-tune on remote sensing imagery firstly for robust domain-specific representation, after which a multimodal decoder with a bi-directional contrastive loss is introduced to achieve deep alignment between visual features and structured textual embeddings. To validate our method, we construct Gaza-Change-v2, a new multi-class change detection (MCD) dataset about the Gaza Strip. On this MCD dataset, S2M achieves a Sek of 17.80\% and an F$_{\text{scd}}$ of 66.14\%, notably surpassing even multimodal methods that leverage large language models. Our work demonstrates that masks can indeed talk. They tell us exactly what, where, how, and how many changes have occurred.

AI.tldr: 本文提出S2M框架，从变化检测数据集已有的标注掩码中自动提取结构化文本特征（语义四元组），无需额外标注成本，实现多模态变化检测，并在新建的Gaza-Change-v2数据集上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感变化检测方法存在两个问题：1) 单模态方法易混淆真实语义变化与视觉相似变化；2) 多模态方法依赖的文本监督要么语义粗糙、要么由模型生成存在噪声，且都忽略了标注掩码本身已编码了细粒度的变化语义信息（位置、类型、转变方式、数量）。
AI.method: 提出S2M框架：1) 将每个变化区域自动转录为语义四元组（where, what, how, how many），并转换为固定模板文本描述；2) 两阶段训练策略：先在遥感图像上微调获取领域表征，再引入多模态解码器和双向对比损失实现视觉与结构化文本的深度对齐。
AI.result: 在新建的Gaza-Change-v2多类别变化检测数据集上，S2M的Sek达17.80%，F_scd达66.14%，显著超越甚至使用大语言模型的多模态方法。
AI.conclusion: 证明了变化检测中的掩码标注本身就能提供精确、密集、无噪声的多模态监督信号，实现"掩码会说话"。

title: Repeated Deceptive Path Planning against Learnable Observer
comment: Full version of the extended abstract accepted at AAMAS 2026
summary: We study the problem of deceptive path planning (DPP), where an agent aims to conceal its true destination from external observers. While existing work assumes static, non-learning observers, real-world adversaries-such as in critical goods transportation or military operations-can adapt by learning from historical trajectories. To address this gap, we introduce Repeated Deceptive Path Planning (RDPP), a new formulation that explicitly models learnable observers. We show that existing DPP methods fail under this setting, as they cannot adapt to evolving adversarial predictions. While incorporating observer previous predictions into updates enables some adaptation, such incremental updates cause accumulative lag that degrades deception. To this end, we propose Deceptive Meta Planning (DeMP), a two-level optimization framework that combines episode-level adaptation, which enables short-term policy adjustment to counter updated observer, and meta-level updates, which leverage cross-episode feedback to capture how observers update their models and accelerate adaptation in future episodes. In this way, DeMP mitigates the accumulation of adaptation lag, enabling sustained deception against a learning observer. Experiments across environments demonstrate that DeMP significantly outperforms existing approaches in RDPP while maintaining competitive path cost. Our results highlight the importance of modeling repeated interactions with learnable adversaries, providing new insights into deception and privacy in multi-agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出重复欺骗路径规划（RDPP）问题，针对可学习的观察者，并设计了双层元学习框架DeMP，通过跨回合反馈实现可持续的路径欺骗。
AI.motivation: 现有欺骗路径规划（DPP）方法假设观察者是静态且非学习的，但现实场景（如军事运输）中的对手会从历史轨迹中学习。为解决这一差距，作者引入RDPP问题，探索如何应对可学习的观察者。
AI.method: 提出Deceptive Meta Planning (DeMP)双层优化框架：上层进行元级更新，利用跨回合反馈学习观察者的更新模式；下层进行回合级适应，根据最新观察者预测调整策略，从而减少累积滞后。
AI.result: 实验表明，DeMP在RDPP环境下显著优于现有DPP方法，同时保持具有竞争力的路径成本。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了建模与可学习对手重复交互的重要性，为多智能体系统中的欺骗与隐私问题提供了新见解。

title: From 0-Order Selection to 2-Order Judgment: Combinatorial Hardening Exposes Compositional Failures in Frontier LLMs
summary: Multiple-choice reasoning benchmarks face dual challenges: rapid saturation from advancing models and data contamination that undermines static evaluations. Ad-hoc hardening methods (paraphrasing, perturbation) attempt to increase difficulty but sacrifice logical validity for surface complexity, falling short to challenge advanced reasoning models. We present LogiHard, a formal framework that deterministically transforms 0-order selection into 2-order logical judgment, which significantly increases the thinking overhead and reasoning steps. The framework integrates Item Response Theory (IRT) for computerized adaptive testing (CAT), enabling precise difficulty control with fewer questions than static benchmarks. We instantiate LogiHard-2k, a logical reasoning dataset constructed by cognitively ranking high-stakes examination questions via 9-dimensional analysis of model thinking traces, followed by combinatorial transformation of high-difficulty items. Evaluation across twelve state-of-the-art models reveals an accuracy degradation ranging from 31% to 56% on combinatorially hardened questions. LLMs suffer from the multi-select failure and early exit bias, which are not shared by human testees. Zero-shot transfer to MMLU demonstrates 47% accuracy degradation (89.84% to 42.86%), confirming applicability across domains with provable validity preservation. The consistent aggregate degeneration is domain-agnostic and stems not from knowledge deficits but from a combinatorial reasoning gap, reflecting a training-induced completeness-verification deficit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LogiHard框架，通过将0阶选择转化为2阶逻辑判断来提升推理难度，结合IRT自适应测试，揭示LLMs存在组合推理缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有多选题基准存在快速饱和和数据污染问题，传统的难度提升方法（释义、扰动）牺牲逻辑有效性却仍无法挑战高级推理模型。
AI.method: 提出LogiHard框架，将0阶选择确定性转化为2阶逻辑判断，集成项目反应理论（IRT）实现自适应测试，并构建LogiHard-2k数据集（基于9维思维痕迹分析+组合变换）。
AI.result: 12个SOTA模型准确率下降31%-56%；LLMs存在多选失败和早期退出偏差（人类受试者无此问题）；MMLU零样本迁移准确率从89.84%降至42.86%（下降47%）。
AI.conclusion: LLMs的性能下降与领域无关，源于组合推理鸿沟（而非知识缺陷），反映训练导致的完备性验证缺陷。

title: Three-in-One World Model: Energy-Based Consistency, Prediction, and Counterfactual Inference for Marketing Intervention
summary: Marketing decisions reflect the interaction of latent consumer heterogeneity, time-varying internal states, and explicit interventions, a structure that current prediction- and language-oriented models do not capture in a unified manner. We propose a Three-in-One world-model architecture in which a Deep Boltzmann Machine (DBM) learns a frozen belief representation from demographics, time, and lagged actions and outcomes, with lightweight task-specific adapters attached on top. The same belief supports three tasks within a single framework: (i) energy-based consistency evaluation through the DBM's free energy, (ii) outcome prediction through adapters, and (iii) counterfactual inference by holding the belief fixed and varying only the action input given to the adapter. Using a controlled simulation in which the latent price sensitivity, promotion responsiveness, and base preference of each consumer are known, we show that the adapters match a strong MLP baseline on visit- and purchase-AUC while recovering heterogeneous treatment effects substantially better than S-, T-, X-, and DR-learner meta-learners and a Causal Forest baseline built on the same raw features, with the largest gap on a confounded price-promotion intervention. Complementing this, free-energy clamps systematically penalize counterfactual purchase trajectories that lack prior promotional exposure, and the penalty itself depends on the latent base preference in the expected direction. These results indicate that DBM beliefs disentangle latent traits in a form that survives counterfactual queries, providing an integrated world-model substrate for marketing intervention.

AI.tldr: 提出一种三合一世界模型架构（Three-in-One），利用深度玻尔兹曼机（DBM）学习冻结的信念表征，同时支持一致性评估、结果预测和反事实推理三种任务，在模拟实验中优于多种元学习器和因果森林基线。
AI.motivation: 现有预测导向和语言导向的模型无法统一捕捉消费者异质性、时变内部状态和显式干预三者之间的交互结构，需要一个统一的框架来同时支持预测、评估和反事实推理。
AI.method: 构建Three-in-One架构：DBM从人口统计、时间、滞后动作和结果中学习冻结的信念表征，其上附加轻量级任务特定适配器。同一信念支持三项任务：基于自由能的能量一致性评估、适配器的结果预测、以及固定信念仅改变动作输入的反事实推理。
AI.result: 在模拟实验中，适配器在访问和购买AUC上匹配强MLP基线；在恢复异质处理效应上大幅优于S、T、X、DR学习器和因果森林基线；自由能钳制机制能系统性地惩罚缺乏促销暴露的反事实购买轨迹，且惩罚强度取决于潜在基础偏好。
AI.conclusion: DBM信念能够以可经受反事实查询的形式解缠潜在特质，为营销干预提供了统一的世界模型基础。

title: MIPIAD: Multilingual Indirect Prompt Injection Attack Defense with Qwen -- TF-IDF Hybrid and Meta-Ensemble Learning
summary: Indirect prompt injection remains a persistent weakness in retrieval-augmented and tool-using LLM systems, and the problem becomes harder to characterise in multilingual settings. We present MIPIAD, a defense framework evaluated on English and Bangla that combines a sequence classifier fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-1.5B via LoRA (XLPID), TF-IDF lexical features, and validation-tuned ensembling through late fusion, stacking, and gradient boosting. The framework is evaluated on a synthetic benchmark built from BIPIA(Yi et al., 2023) templates spanning five task families -- email, table, QA, abstract, and code-comprising over 1.43 million generated samples, with train and test splits using mutually exclusive attack categories. Across the experiments, lexical signals prove strong (TF-IDF+SVM F1=0.77), and the hybrid XLPID+TF-IDF ensemble achieves the best overall F1 (0.9205) while the Boosting Ensemble achieves the best AUROC (0.9378). Ensemble methods consistently reduce the English-Bangla cross-lingual gap relative to standalone neural models. The pipeline is designed for extensibility: NLLB-200 supports over 200 languages and XLPID's multilingual backbone can be retargeted to additional languages without architectural changes; empirical validation is currently limited to English and Bangla

AI.tldr: 针对多语言环境下检索增强LLM系统的间接提示注入攻击，提出MIPIAD防御框架，通过结合序列分类器（XLPID）、TF-IDF特征和集成学习方法，在英语和孟加拉语数据集上达到0.9205的F1分数和0.9378的AUROC。该框架支持扩展到200多种语言。
AI.motivation: 间接提示注入仍然是检索增强和工具使用型LLM系统的持续弱点，而在多语言环境下这一问题更加难以表征和防御。
AI.method: 提出MIPIAD框架，结合三种组件：基于LoRA微调Qwen2.5-1.5B的序列分类器（XLPID）、TF-IDF词汇特征、以及通过晚融合、堆叠和梯度提升验证调优的集成方法。在基于BIPIA模板构建的合成基准上评估，涵盖5个任务家族（邮件、表格、问答、摘要、代码），共143万样本。
AI.result: TF-IDF+SVM F1=0.77；混合XLPID+TF-IDF集成达到最佳F1分数0.9205；Boosting集成达到最佳AUROC 0.9378。集成方法一致地缩小了英语-孟加拉语跨语言差距。
AI.conclusion: 词汇信号在防御中表现强劲，集成方法有效提升整体性能并减少跨语言差距。框架设计支持可扩展性：NLLB-200支持200多种语言，XLPID的多语言骨干可适配额外语言而无需架构更改。目前实证验证限于英语和孟加拉语。

title: Understanding Performance Collapse in Layer-Pruned Large Language Models via Decision Representation Transitions
summary: Layer pruning efficiently reduces Large Language Model (LLM) computational costs but often triggers sudden performance collapse. Existing representation-based analyses struggle to explain this mechanism. We propose studying pruning through decision representation. Focusing on multiple-choice tasks, we introduce two metrics, Decision Margin and Option Frequency, and an Iterative Pruning method to analyze layer-wise decision dynamics. Our findings reveal a sharp decision transition that partitions the network into two stages: a Silent Phase, where the model cannot yet predict the correct answer, and a Decisive Phase, where the correct prediction emerges. We also find that pruning the Decisive Phase has minimal impact, whereas pruning the Silent Phase triggers immediate performance collapse, highlighting its extreme sensitivity to structural changes. Therefore, we conclude that pruning-induced collapse stems from disrupting the Silent Phase, which prevents the critical decision transition from occurring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出决策表示分析框架，通过决策边界和选项频率两个指标，发现大模型层间存在从“静默阶段”到“决策阶段”的尖锐转变，剪枝静默阶段会导致性能崩溃。
AI.motivation: 现有基于表示的分析方法难以解释大模型层剪枝中突然的性能崩溃机制，亟需从决策表示角度理解这一现象。
AI.method: 提出决策边界（Decision Margin）和选项频率（Option Frequency）两个指标，并设计迭代剪枝方法，在多项选择任务上逐层分析模型的决策动态。
AI.result: 发现网络存在从静默阶段（无法预测正确答案）到决策阶段（正确答案出现）的尖锐转变；剪枝决策阶段影响微小，而剪枝静默阶段会立即引发性能崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 剪枝导致的性能崩溃源于对静默阶段的破坏，阻止了关键的决策转变过程。

title: Attention Transfer Is Not Universally Effective for Vision Transformers
summary: A recent work shows that Attention Transfer, which transfers only the attention patterns from a pre-trained teacher Vision Transformer (ViT) to a randomly initialized standard student ViT, is sufficient to recover the full benefit of the teacher's pre-trained weights. We revisit this finding on a comprehensive benchmark of 20 teachers from 11 well-known ViT families and reveal that Attention Transfer is not universally effective. While 7 families transfer successfully, 4 consistently fail, falling up to 5.1\% below the from-scratch no-transfer baseline. Further results demonstrate that this failure is family-consistent across model sizes, and persists under extended training durations, different transfer datasets, and out-of-distribution evaluations. Controlled analyses then consistently localize the problem to the attention-routing channel, indicating that the key issue is not whether the student can match the teacher's attention patterns, but whether the matched patterns remain functional for the student. Crucially, we identify architectural mismatch between the pre-trained teacher and the standard student as the primary mechanism. By adding only the teacher's native architectural components to the student in a randomly initialized state, we completely reverse the failure for all 4 families. Notably, these components alone do not improve from-scratch training, confirming that they specifically unlock the usability of the teacher's attention. We further systematically show that this failure is not explained by the inadequate choice of transfer loss or by differences in pre-training recipes. Our findings refine the prevailing understanding of attention in ViT representations: attention is sufficient \textit{only} when the student architecture matches the teacher.

AI.tldr: 本文发现注意力迁移（Attention Transfer）并非普遍有效：在20个教师模型中，4个家族的迁移失败，性能比从头训练基线低5.1%；失败的根本原因是师生架构不匹配，通过为学生添加教师特有的架构组件（即使随机初始化）即可完全逆转失败。
AI.motivation: 先前研究声称仅迁移注意力模式就能完全恢复预训练权重的好处，本文旨在检验这一发现在更大范围ViT家族中的普适性，并探究迁移失败的原因。
AI.method: 在11个ViT家族的20个教师模型上进行系统基准测试；通过增加训练时长、更换迁移数据集、分布外评估等消融实验定位问题；通过为学生添加教师架构组件进行因果验证。
AI.result: 7个ViT家族迁移成功，4个家族迁移失败（性能低于从头训练基线最多5.1%）；失败具有家族一致性且无法通过延长训练或更换数据解决；添加教师特有架构组件可完全逆转失败。
AI.conclusion: 注意力迁移仅在学生架构与教师匹配时有效；架构不匹配是迁移失败的主要机制；注意力模式的功能性比可匹配性更为关键。

title: HMACE: Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Collaborative Evolution for Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Large Language Models have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for automated heuristic design for NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems. Despite this progress, existing LLM-based methods typically rely on monolithic workflows constrained by rigid templates, thereby restricting memory-guided exploration and triggering premature convergence to local optima. To design an autonomous and collaborative architecture, we introduce HMACE, a Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Collaborative Evolution framework that reconceptualizes heuristic search as an organizational design problem. HMACE decomposes each evolutionary generation into an autonomous, role-specialized loop with four coordinated agents: a Proposer for strategy exploration, a Generator for executable heuristic synthesis, an Evaluator for empirical assessment, and a Reflector for archive-backed memory update. By coupling behavior-aware retrieval, lightweight candidate filtering, and fitness-grounded archive updates, HMACE guides the search toward diverse and promising heuristic behaviors while avoiding redundant evaluations. Extensive evaluations on representative COPs, including TSP, Online BPP, MKP, and PFSP, show that HMACE achieves a favorable quality-efficiency trade-off compared to state-of-the-art single-agent and multi-agent baselines. In the matched LLM-driven reference comparison, HMACE achieves the lowest average gaps on TSP and Online BPP (0.464\% and 0.223\%, respectively), while requiring only 0.13M and 0.42M tokens for the two tasks, substantially fewer than the compared baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出HMACE框架，将启发式搜索重构为多智能体协作进化问题，通过四个角色专业化智能体（提出者、生成器、评估者、反思者）协同工作，在TSP、Online BPP、MKP和PFSP等NP-hard组合优化问题上实现了质量与效率的优越平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的自动化启发式设计方法依赖单一工作流和刚性模板，限制了记忆引导的探索能力，容易过早收敛到局部最优解。
AI.method: 提出HMACE（异构多智能体协作进化框架），将每一代进化分解为四个角色专业化智能体的自主循环：Proposer负责策略探索，Generator生成可执行启发式，Evaluator进行经验评估，Reflector基于存档进行记忆更新。耦合行为感知检索、轻量级候选过滤和适应度驱动存档更新。
AI.result: 在TSP、Online BPP、MKP和PFSP上超越单智能体和多智能体基线。在LLM驱动参考对比中，TSP和Online BPP上平均差距最低（0.464%和0.223%），且仅需0.13M和0.42M tokens。
AI.conclusion: HMACE通过多智能体协作和记忆引导的探索机制，有效避免了局部最优收敛，实现了启发式搜索中质量与效率的更好权衡。

title: AsyncEvGS: Asynchronous Event-Assisted Gaussian Splatting for Handheld Motion-Blurred Scenes
summary: 3D reconstruction methods such as 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) and Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) achieve impressive photorealism but fail when input images suffer from severe motion blur. While event cameras provide high-temporal-resolution motion cues, existing event-assisted approaches rely on low-resolution sensors and strict synchronization, limiting their practicality for handheld 3D capture on common devices, such as smartphones. We introduce a flexible, high-resolution asynchronous RGB-Event dual-camera system and a corresponding reconstruction framework. Our approach first reconstructs sharp images from the event data and then employs a cross-domain pose estimation module based on the Visual Geometry Transformer (VGGT) to obtain robust initialization for 3DGS. During optimization, we employ a structure-driven event loss and view-specific consistency regularizers to mitigate the ill-posed behavior of traditional event losses and deblurring losses, ensuring both stable and high-fidelity reconstruction. We further contribute AsyncEv-Deblur, a new high-resolution RGB-Event dataset captured with our asynchronous system. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on both our challenging dataset and existing benchmarks, substantially improving reconstruction robustness under severe motion blur. Project page: https://openimaginglab.github.io/AsyncEvGS/

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种灵活的高分辨率异步RGB-事件双相机系统及重建框架（AsyncEvGS），通过事件数据重建清晰图像、基于VGGT的跨域姿态估计和结构驱动的事件损失，有效解决了严重运动模糊下的3D重建问题，并在新数据集AsyncEv-Deblur上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS和NeRF方法在输入图像存在严重运动模糊时效果不佳，而现有事件辅助方法依赖低分辨率传感器和严格同步，限制了在手持设备（如智能手机）上的实际应用。
AI.method: 首先从事件数据重建清晰图像，再利用基于VGGT的跨域姿态估计模块获得鲁棒的3DGS初始化，优化过程中采用结构驱动的事件损失和视角特定一致性正则化项来缓解传统事件损失和去模糊损失的不适定性问题。
AI.result: 在自建的高分辨率异步RGB-Event数据集AsyncEv-Deblur和现有基准上均达到SOTA性能，显著提升了严重运动模糊下的重建鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的异步RGB-Event双相机系统及重建框架有效克服了运动模糊对3D重建的影响，为手持设备上的高保真3D捕捉提供了实用解决方案。

title: MEMOREPAIR: Barrier-First Cascade Repair in Agentic Memory
summary: Agentic memory evolves across tasks into durable derived artifacts: summaries, cached outputs, embeddings, learned skills, and executable tool procedures. When a source artifact is deleted, corrected, or invalidated by tool or API migration, descendants derived from that source can remain visible and steer future actions with stale support. We formalize this failure mode as the cascade update problem, where repair targets the visible derived state of the memory store. We present MemoRepair, a barrier-first cascade-repair contract for agentic memory. A repair event induces a controlled transition from invalidated descendant state to validated successor state: affected descendants are withdrawn before repair, successors are constructed from retained support and staged repaired predecessors under the current interface, and republication is restricted to validated predecessor-closed successors. This contract induces a scalarized repair-selection problem for a fixed repair-cost tradeoff. We show that the induced publication problem reduces to maximum-weight predecessor closure and can be solved exactly by a single s-t min-cut. Experiments on ToolBench and MemoryArena show that, with complete influence provenance, MemoRepair reduces invalidated-memory exposure from 69.8-94.3% under systems without cascade repair to 0%. Compared with exhaustive Repair all, it recovers 91.1-94.3% of validated successors while reducing normalized repair-operator cost from 1.00 to 0.57-0.76.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemoRepair，一种用于智能体记忆系统的级联修复协议。当记忆源制品被删除或失效时，从其派生的后代制品会残留并误导智能体行为。MemoRepair通过"屏障优先"的级联修复策略，在修复事件中撤回受影响的派生记忆，用保留的支持和已修复的前驱构建有效后继，并限制发布。实验表明，在完全影响溯源下，该方法能将无效记忆暴露率从69.8-94.3%降至0%，并相比全量修复节省24-43%的修复成本。
AI.motivation: 智能体记忆系统中存在级联更新问题：当源记忆制品被删除、修正或因工具/API迁移失效时，从该源派生的后代记忆仍然可见并持续影响智能体决策，导致基于陈旧或无效记忆的行动误导。
AI.method: 提出MemoRepair屏障优先级联修复协议：修复事件触发从无效后代状态到有效后继状态的受控转换——受影响后代在修复前被撤回，后继由保留的支持和已修复的前驱在当前接口下构建，发布限制为验证过的前驱闭包后继。该问题被形式化为标量化修复选择问题，发布子问题归约为最大权重前驱闭包问题，可通过单一s-t最小割精确求解。
AI.result: 在ToolBench和MemoryArena上的实验显示：在完全影响溯源下，MemoRepair将无效记忆暴露率从无级联修复系统的69.8-94.3%降至0%。相比全量修复策略，恢复了91.1-94.3%的有效后继，同时将归一化修复算子成本从1.00降至0.57-0.76。
AI.conclusion: MemoRepair有效解决了智能体记忆系统中的级联更新问题，通过受控的修复协议在保证记忆有效性的同时显著降低了修复成本，为构建更可靠的智能体记忆系统提供了理论基础和实用方法。

title: Rethinking Dense Sequential Chains: Reasoning Language Models Can Extract Answers from Sparse, Order-Shuffling Chain-of-Thoughts
summary: Modern reasoning language models generate dense, sequential chain-of-thought traces implicitly assuming that every token contributes and that steps must be consumed in order. We challenge both assumptions through a systematic intervention pipeline--removal, masking, shuffling, and noise injection--applied to model-generated reasoning chains across three models and three benchmarks. Our findings are counterintuitive on three dimensions. Order: Does the sequential order of a reasoning chain matter for answer extraction? No--line-level shuffling reduces accuracy by less than 0.5 pp; word-level shuffling retains 62%-89% accuracy; only token-level shuffling collapses to near zero. Pretrained-only and instruction-tuned variants exhibit near-identical tolerance (78.67% vs. 78.00% under line shuffling), indicating order-independence originates from pretraining rather than reasoning-specific fine-tuning. Dense: Is all the information in a reasoning chain important for answer extraction? No--masking numeric digits collapses accuracy to exactly 0%, while masking alphabetic prose improves accuracy by 4.7 pp. Robustness: Is a reasoning chain that is both order-shuffling and non-dense still robust? Yes--the most aggressively reduced representation (all natural language removed, lines arbitrarily shuffled) still achieves 83% accuracy, and injecting false answers at 3x true-answer frequency leaves accuracy unchanged (83.3%->83.3%), falsifying a frequency-based extraction account. These results establish that answer extraction operates on a sparse, order-insensitive, and structurally robust informational substrate, opening paths toward parallelized and token-efficient reasoning generation.

AI.tldr: 现代推理语言模型生成的思维链并非顺序依赖且非密集：行级打乱准确率几乎不变，数字掩码导致准确率归零而文字掩码反而提升准确率，即使在最激进的压缩（移除所有自然语言+任意打乱）下仍能保持83%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 挑战现有推理语言模型的两个隐含假设：推理链中每个token都有贡献，且推理步骤必须按顺序消费。
AI.method: 设计系统性干预流程（移除、掩码、打乱、噪声注入），对三个模型在三个基准上的推理链进行破坏性分析。
AI.result: 1）顺序不重要：行级打乱准确率下降不足0.5pp，词级打乱保持62%-89%准确率，仅token级打乱导致崩溃；2）信息非密集：数字掩码使准确率归零，文字掩码反而提升4.7pp；3）鲁棒性强：最激进压缩仍达83%准确率，注入3倍虚假答案不影响准确率。
AI.conclusion: 答案提取操作在稀疏、顺序不敏感、结构鲁棒的信息基底上进行，为并行化和token高效推理生成开辟了新路径。

title: Closed-Form Linear-Probe Dataset Distillation for Pre-trained Vision Models
summary: Dataset distillation compresses a large training set into a small synthetic set that preserves downstream training utility. While most existing methods target training networks from scratch, modern visual transfer learning often uses frozen pre-trained encoders followed by lightweight linear probing. Existing distillation methods for this setting either unroll iterative linear-probe updates with trajectory-based gradient matching, or rely on closed-form formulations originally designed for from-scratch training with neural-tangent-kernel (NTK) approximations. Neither route exploits the fact that frozen-feature linear probing admits a closed-form solution determined directly by the pre-trained features themselves, with no infinite-width approximation and no inner-loop trajectory. We propose Closed-Form Linear-Probe Dataset Distillation (CLP-DD), a bilevel formulation that computes the linear probe induced by the synthetic set with a sample-space kernel ridge solver. The synthetic images are then updated by evaluating this induced classifier on real features through a temperature-scaled softmax cross-entropy, where the classifier columns act as learned class anchors in feature space. We further show that the choice of outer objective is decisive: pairing the closed-form inner solver with a standard MSE outer loss substantially underperforms trajectory-based methods, while the discriminative outer loss closes most of the gap. On ImageNet-100 with four pre-trained backbones, CLP-DD substantially improves over LGM without DSA and approaches LGM with DSA at a fraction of the computational cost. On ImageNet-1K, CLP-DD matches or surpasses LGM with DSA on three of four backbones while running roughly $14\times$ faster and using less than one-eighth of the GPU memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CLP-DD方法，利用冻结特征线性探测的闭式解进行数据集蒸馏，无需无限宽度近似或内循环轨迹，在ImageNet上以更低计算成本达到或超越现有方法性能。
AI.motivation: 现有针对冻结预训练编码器+线性探测场景的数据集蒸馏方法要么使用轨迹梯度匹配（计算昂贵），要么依赖神经正切核（NTK）近似（需无限宽度假设）。两者都忽略了冻结特征线性探测本身存在闭式解这一事实。
AI.method: 提出双层优化框架：内层用核岭回归闭式求解合成集诱导的线性探测分类器；外层用温度缩放的softmax交叉熵损失评估该分类器在真实特征上的表现。指出外层损失函数选择至关重要：MSE损失效果差，判别性损失效果好。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-100上，CLP-DD显著优于无DSA的LGM，性能接近有DSA的LGM；在ImageNet-1K上，在4个预训练骨干中的3个上匹配或超越LGM（含DSA），运行速度快约14倍，GPU内存消耗不到1/8。
AI.conclusion: 冻结特征线性探测的闭式解结合判别性外层损失是一种高效且有效的数据集蒸馏范式，在保持性能的同时大幅降低计算开销。

title: EnvSimBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating and Improving LLM-Based Environment Simulation
summary: Scalable AI agents training relies on interactive environments that faithfully simulate the consequences of agent actions. Manually crafted environments are expensive to build, brittle to extend, and fundamentally limited in diversity. A promising direction is to replace manually crafted environments with LLM-simulated counterparts. However, this paradigm hinges on an unexamined core assumption: LLMs can accurately simulate environmental feedback. In practice, LLM-simulated environments suffer from hallucinations, logical inconsistencies, and silent state drift failures that corrupt agent reward signals and compound the construction costs that the paradigm was designed to eliminate. To address this gap, we propose EnvSimBench with four contributions: 1) We provide the first formal definition and operationalization of Environment Simulation Ability (EnvSim Ability) as a quantifiable research objective. 2) We construct EnvSimBench, a rigorous benchmark covering 400 samples across 167 diverse environments, equipped with verifiable labels and fine-grained difficulty stratification along three axes. 3) Systematic evaluations reveal that all state-of-the-art language models suffer from a universal state change cliff: they achieve near-perfect accuracy on tasks when the environment state remains invariant, yet fail catastrophically when multiple states need simultaneous updates. This finding exposes EnvSim Ability as a critical yet largely unaddressed capability gap. 4) We design a constraint-driven simulation pipeline that substantially reduces hallucination, boosts environment synthesis yield by 6.8%, and cuts costs by over 90%. Overall, EnvSimBench serves as both a diagnostic framework and a practical optimization path for reliable LLM-based environment simulation, establishing a foundation for scalable agent training. Code and data are available at https://github.com/cookieApril/EnvSimBench

AI.tldr: 本文提出EnvSimBench，首次正式定义并量化了环境模拟能力（EnvSim Ability），构建了涵盖167个环境的400样本基准测试，发现所有大语言模型都存在“状态变化悬崖”这一通用缺陷，并设计了约束驱动模拟管线，将幻觉减少、合成产出提升6.8%、成本降低90%以上。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的环境模拟存在幻觉、逻辑不一致和状态漂移等问题，破坏了智能体训练的奖励信号，且增加了构建成本。需要系统性地定义、量化和解决LLM的环境模拟能力缺陷。
AI.method: 1) 首次形式化定义EnvSim Ability；2) 构建EnvSimBench基准（400样本，167个环境，含可验证标签和三轴难度分层）；3) 系统评估主流LLM的环境模拟表现；4) 设计约束驱动模拟管线优化模拟质量与成本。
AI.result: 所有顶尖语言模型存在“状态变化悬崖”：状态不变时接近完美准确率，多状态同时更新时灾难性失败。提出的约束驱动管线减少幻觉、合成产出提升6.8%、成本降低超90%。
AI.conclusion: EnvSimAbility是当前LLM尚未解决的关键能力缺口，EnvSimBench既可作为诊断框架，也为可靠的LLM环境模拟提供了优化路径，为可扩展的智能体训练奠定基础。

title: LaTER: Efficient Test-Time Reasoning via Latent Exploration and Explicit Verification
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning improves large language models (LLMs) on difficult tasks, but it also makes inference expensive because every intermediate step must be generated as a discrete token. Latent reasoning reduces visible token generation by propagating continuous states, yet replacing explicit derivations with latent computation can hurt tasks that require symbolic checking. We propose Latent-Then-Explicit Reasoning (LaTER), a two-stage paradigm that first performs bounded exploration in a continuous latent space and then switches to explicit CoT for verification and answer generation. In a training-free instantiation, LaTER projects final-layer hidden states back to the input embedding space, preserves the latent KV cache, and uses entropy and model-native stop-token probes to decide when to switch. We find that strong reasoning models already exhibit structured latent trajectories under this interface. On Qwen3-14B, training-free LaTER reduces total token usage by 16%-32% on several benchmarks while matching or improving accuracy on most of them; for example, it improves AIME 2025 from 70.0% to 73.3% while reducing tokens from 15,730 to 10,661. We further construct Latent-Switch-69K, a supervised corpus that pairs condensed solution intuitions with shortened explicit derivations. Fine-tuning with latent rollout and halting supervision yields additional gains: trained LaTER reaches 80.0% accuracy on AIME 2025, 10.0 points above the standard CoT baseline, while using 33% fewer tokens. Our code, data, and model are available at https://github.com/TioeAre/LaTER.

AI.tldr: LaTER提出了一种两阶段推理范式：先在连续潜在空间中进行有限探索，再切换到显式思维链进行验证和答案生成，在减少16%-32%token用量的同时保持甚至提升推理准确率。
AI.motivation: CoT推理虽然提升了LLM在困难任务上的表现，但每个中间步骤都需要生成离散token，导致推理成本高昂；而潜在推理虽然减少了可见token，但完全替换为潜在计算会损害需要符号检查的任务。
AI.method: 两阶段范式：第一阶段在连续潜在空间中进行有界探索（通过将最终层隐藏状态投影回输入嵌入空间并保留潜在KV缓存）；第二阶段使用熵和模型原生停止标记探针决定何时切换到显式CoT进行验证和答案生成。同时构建了Latent-Switch-69K监督语料，通过潜在展开和停止监督进行微调。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-14B上，无训练LaTER减少了16%-32%的token用量，同时匹配或提升了多数基准的准确率；AIME 2025从70.0%提升至73.3%，token从15,730降至10,661。微调后的LaTER在AIME 2025上达到80.0%准确率，比标准CoT基线高出10.0个百分点，同时节省33%的token。
AI.conclusion: LaTER有效结合了潜在推理的高效性和显式推理的准确性，在降低推理成本的同时提升了模型性能，证明了强推理模型在潜在空间中的结构化轨迹可用于高效推理。

title: Can Agents Price a Reaction? Evaluating LLMs on Chemical Cost Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become increasingly capable as tool-using agents, with benchmarks spanning diverse general agentic tasks. Yet rigorous evaluation of scientific tool use remains limited. In chemistry, recent agents can plan syntheses and invoke domain-specific tools, but evaluations often rely on curated demonstrations, expert assessment, or LLM-as-judge scoring rather than exact, judge-free ground truth. We address this gap with chemical procurement cost estimation, a practical task in which an agent must ground chemical identities, retrieve supplier quotes, select valid purchasable packs, normalize quantities, and compute cost from a reaction description. We introduce ChemCost, a benchmark of 1,427 evaluable reactions grounded to a frozen pricing snapshot covering 2,261 chemicals and 230,775 supplier quotes, supporting scalar scoring and stage-level diagnosis of grounding, retrieval, procurement, and arithmetic failures. To evaluate robustness, we further construct controlled noise-injected views that perturb chemical aliases, quantity expressions, missing fields, and input formatting. Experiments with frontier, open-weight, and chemistry-specialized LLM agents show that tool access is necessary but insufficient for solving the task. The strongest agents reach only 50.6% accuracy within 25% relative error on clean inputs and degrade substantially with realistic noise. Stage-level analysis further shows that failures arise from brittle parsing, ineffective evidence integration, invalid pack selection, and non-convergent tool use.

AI.tldr: 提出了ChemCost基准，用于评估LLM在化学采购成本估算任务中的工具使用能力。最强模型在干净输入上准确率仅50.6%，存在解析脆弱、证据整合无效等系统性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有科学工具使用评估多依赖人工演示或LLM判分，缺乏基于精确ground truth的客观评价。化学领域的智能体评估存在这一空白。
AI.method: 构建含1,427个可评估反应的ChemCost基准，覆盖2,261种化学品和230,775条供应商报价，设计标量评分和阶段级诊断（grounding、检索、采购、算术），并引入受控噪声注入测试。
AI.result: 最强智能体（前沿模型）在干净输入下仅达50.6%准确率（25%相对误差内），在含噪声输入下性能显著下降。阶段分析显示失败源于解析脆弱、证据整合无效、包装选择不合理及工具使用不收敛。
AI.conclusion: 工具访问对于该任务是必要但不充分的，当前LLM智能体在科学工具使用的鲁棒性上存在明显不足，需要改进解析、推理和工具调用能力。

title: Activation Differences Reveal Backdoors: A Comparison of SAE Architectures
summary: Backdoor attacks on language models pose a significant threat to AI safety, where models behave normally on most inputs but exhibit harmful behavior when triggered by specific patterns. Detecting such backdoors through mechanistic interpretability remains an open challenge. We investigate two sparse autoencoder architectures -- Crosscoders and Differential SAEs (Diff-SAE) -- for isolating backdoor-related features in fine-tuned models. Using a controlled SQL injection backdoor triggered by year-based context ("2024" triggers vulnerable code, "2023" triggers safe code), we evaluate both approaches across LoRA and full-rank fine-tuning regimes on SmolLM2-360M. We find that Diff-SAE consistently and substantially outperforms Crosscoders for backdoor isolation. Diff-SAE achieves a Backdoor Isolation Score (BIS) of 0.40 with perfect precision (1.0) and zero false positive rate across most experimental conditions, while Crosscoders fail almost entirely with BIS below 0.02 in most cases. This performance gap holds across multiple transformer layers (14, 18, 22, 26) and both fine-tuning regimes, with full-rank fine-tuning producing particularly clean backdoor signals. Our results suggest that backdoors manifest as directional activation shifts rather than sparse feature activations, making difference-based representations fundamentally more effective for detection. These findings have important implications for AI safety monitoring and the development of interpretability tools for detecting model manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了两种稀疏自编码器架构（Crosscoders 和 Diff-SAE）在检测语言模型后门攻击中的效果，发现 Diff-SAE 显著优于 Crosscoders，能更有效地隔离后门相关特征，实现精确检测且无假阳性。
AI.motivation: 后门攻击对语言模型安全构成严重威胁，但通过机制可解释性检测后门仍是一个未解决的挑战。
AI.method: 在 SmolLM2-360M 模型上，利用 SQL 注入后门（"2024"触发漏洞代码，"2023"触发安全代码），分别在 LoRA 和全秩微调条件下，评估 Crosscoders 和 Diff-SAE 两种稀疏自编码器架构的后门隔离能力。
AI.result: Diff-SAE 的后门隔离得分（BIS）达 0.40，精确率 1.0，假阳性率为 0；而 Crosscoders 的 BIS 低于 0.02。该性能差距在多个 Transformer 层和两种微调方式下一致成立。
AI.conclusion: 后门表现为方向性的激活偏移而非稀疏特征激活，因此基于差异的表示方法（Diff-SAE）在检测后门方面更有效，对 AI 安全监控和可解释性工具开发具有重要意义。

title: From Pixels to Primitives: Scene Change Detection in 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Scene change detection methods built on Gaussian splatting universally follow a render-then-compare paradigm: the pre-change scene is rendered into 2D and compared against post-change images via pixel or feature residuals. This change detection problem with Gaussian Splatting has been treated as a question about pixels; we treat it as a question about primitives. We provide direct evidence that native primitive attributes alone -- position, anisotropic covariance, and color -- carry sufficient signal for scene change detection. What makes primitive-space comparison hard is the under-constrained nature of Gaussian splatting representation: independent optimizations yield primitive solutions whose count, positions, shapes, and colors differ even where nothing has changed. We address this challenge with anisotropic models of geometric and photometric drift, complemented by a per-primitive observability term that reflects the extent to which each Gaussian is constrained by the camera geometry. Operating directly on primitives gives our method, GD-DIFF, two properties that distinguish it from render-then-compare methods. First, change maps are multi-view consistent by construction, where prior work had to learn this through an additional optimization objective. Second, geometric and appearance changes are scored separately, identifying not just where but what kind of change occurred, distinguishing structural changes (e.g., an added object) from surface-level ones (e.g., a color change) without supervision or external model dependencies. On real-world benchmarks, GS-DIFF surpasses the prior state-of-the-art approach by approximatelt 17% in mean Intersection over Union.

AI.tldr: 提出GD-DIFF方法，直接在3D高斯原始属性（位置、协方差、颜色）上进行场景变化检测，解决了高斯泼溅表示中因独立优化导致的原始空间不对齐问题，通过各向异性漂移模型和可观测性项实现多视角一致且区分几何/外观变化的检测，性能提升约17% mIoU。
AI.motivation: 现有基于高斯泼溅的场景变化检测普遍采用"先渲染再比较"的像素范式，但这种方法将三维空间中的变化问题降维到二维像素空间处理，丢失了原始结构信息。作者希望直接在原始属性空间进行变化检测，以获得多视角一致性和变化类型区分能力。
AI.method: 1) 提出原始空间变化检测范式，直接比较高斯原始属性（位置、各向异性协方差、颜色）；2) 设计各向异性几何漂移模型和光度漂移模型，解决独立优化导致的原始不对齐问题；3) 引入逐原始可观测性项，衡量每个高斯被相机几何约束的程度；4) 在原始空间分别计算几何变化和外观变化分数。
AI.result: 在真实世界基准测试中，GD-DIFF相比之前最先进的方法，平均交并比（mIoU）提升约17%。
AI.conclusion: 直接在3D原始属性空间进行变化检测是可行且优越的，能够天然获得多视角一致性，无需额外学习；同时能够无监督地区分结构变化（如新增物体）和表面变化（如颜色变化），为场景变化检测提供了新的研究思路。

title: Structured Role-Aware Policy Optimization for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR), especially with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has shown strong potential for improving the reasoning capabilities of large vision-language models (LVLMs). However, in multimodal reasoning, final-answer rewards are typically assigned at the sequence level and do not distinguish the functional roles of different tokens, making it difficult to determine whether a correct answer is supported by task-relevant visual evidence. In this paper, we revisit multimodal RLVR from the perspective of role-aware token-level credit assignment, where structured responses are decomposed into perception tokens for extracting visual evidence and reasoning tokens for deriving answers from that evidence. Based on this perspective, we propose Structured Role-aware Policy Optimization (SRPO), which refines the sequence-level GRPO advantage into role-aware token-level advantages without changing the reward function. Specifically, SRPO assigns role-specific credit by using self-distilled on-policy contrasts: perception tokens are emphasized according to their visual dependency under original versus corrupted visual inputs, while reasoning tokens are emphasized according to their consistency with the generated perception. These role-specific signals are further unified through a shared trajectory-level baseline, yielding positive token weights that adjust relative update magnitudes while preserving the original GRPO reward and optimization direction, without requiring external reward models or separate teachers. Experiments across diverse multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that SRPO improves evidence-grounded reasoning, highlighting the importance of moving beyond uniform sequence-level credit toward role-aware optimization for reliable multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结构化角色感知策略优化（SRPO），通过将序列级GRPO优势分解为角色感知的token级优势，在无需改变奖励函数或引入外部模型的情况下，提升多模态推理中视觉证据与推理过程的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态RLVR方法（如GRPO）仅给序列级最终答案分配奖励，无法区分不同token的功能角色（如感知token vs. 推理token），导致难以判断正确答案是否基于任务相关的视觉证据。
AI.method: 提出SRPO方法：将结构化响应分解为感知token和推理token，通过自蒸馏在线对比机制分配角色特定的信用——感知token根据原始/损坏视觉输入下的视觉依赖性加权，推理token根据与生成感知的一致性加权；再通过共享轨迹级基线统一，生成正向token权重调整更新幅度，无需外部奖励模型或单独教师网络。
AI.result: 在多个多模态推理基准上，SRPO相比基线方法显著提升了基于证据的推理能力，表明从统一序列级信用转向角色感知优化对于可靠多模态推理的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 多模态RLVR需要超越简单的序列级信用分配，采用角色感知的token级优化策略，才能确保推理过程真正基于视觉证据，提升多模态大语言模型推理的可靠性和可解释性。

title: Mean-Pooled Cosine Similarity is Not Length-Invariant: Theory and Cross-Domain Evidence for a Length-Invariant Alternative
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026
summary: Mean-pooled cosine similarity is the default metric for comparing neural representations across languages, modalities, and tasks. We establish that this metric is not length-invariant: under the anisotropy that characterizes modern transformer representations, mean-pooled cosine grows monotonically in sequence length, independent of representational content. Empirically, on HumanEvalPack across four code LLMs, the length ratio alone explains $R^2 = 0.52$--$0.75$ of cross-language "Python proximity," while AST depth and shared-token fraction add less than 3% of explained variance beyond length. Substituting Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) reduces explained variance by 83% and reverses the sign of the length coefficient ($β_{\mathrm{len}}: +0.86 \to -0.37$). The same pattern holds in Mistral-7B on parallel WMT pairs ($R^2 = 0.23$ EN-FR, $R^2 = 0.33$ EN-DE for cosine; $R^2 < 0.01$ for CKA). In CLIP ViT-B/32, mean-pooling reduces the length effect relative to EOS-pooling ($R^2: 0.21 \to {<}0.01$), as predicted by the theory's dependence on anisotropy. We argue that length-invariant metrics such as CKA should be the default for cross-representation comparisons, and that recent claims of cross-lingual representational convergence built on mean-pooled cosine warrant re-examination.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，平均池化余弦相似度（mean-pooled cosine）并非长度不变的度量标准，在具有各向异性的Transformer表示中，该指标会随序列长度单调增长。通过多项实验验证了该问题，并建议使用CKA等长度不变指标替代。
AI.motivation: 当前广泛使用平均池化余弦相似度来比较跨语言、跨模态和跨任务的神经表示，但该指标是否真正可靠尚未得到充分检验。
AI.method: 理论分析表明平均池化余弦相似度在Transformer表示的各向异性下不具备长度不变性；通过HumanEvalPack（四类代码LLM）、WMT平行语料（Mistral-7B）和CLIP ViT-B/32等实验进行验证，并与CKA进行对比。
AI.result: 在HumanEvalPack上，长度比单独可解释52%-75%的“Python接近度”方差；CKA使解释方差降低83%并反转长度系数符号。类似模式在Mistral-7B和CLIP中也被观察到。
AI.conclusion: 平均池化余弦相似度因长度偏差可能导致误导性结论，建议采用CKA等长度不变指标作为跨表示比较的默认方法，并呼吁重新审视基于该指标得出的跨语言表示收敛性结论。

title: LoHGNet: Infrared Small Target Detection through Lorentz Geometric Encoding with High-Order Relation Learning
summary: Infrared small target detection (IRSTD) remains challenging due to the scarcity of useful target cues and the presence of severe background clutter. Most current methods rely on conventional feature learning and local interaction modeling, where features are represented in Euclidean space. However, such designs may still be limited in describing the subtle differences of weak targets and the contextual relations between targets and backgrounds. To address these limitations, we propose LoHGNet, an IRSTD network that integrates Lorentz geometric encoding with high-order relation learning. By introducing Lorentz manifold based feature learning, LoHGNet offers a different feature representation from conventional IRSTD methods and provides new discriminative cues for IRSTD. Specifically, a Lorentz encoding branch is constructed with the Geometric Attention Guided Lorentz Residual Convolution Module (GA-LRCM) to perform feature modeling under hyperbolic geometric constraints and enhance the hierarchical geometric representation capability of weak targets. Subsequently, the hyperbolic features are mapped into the Euclidean tangent space through logarithmic mapping, and a High-Order Relation Learning Module (HORL) is designed to model the high-order contextual dependencies between targets and backgrounds via hypergraph construction, thereby improving target discrimination in complex backgrounds. Experimental results on three datasets demonstrate that the proposed LoHGNet achieves competitive performance in both detection accuracy and adaptability to complex scenes. The code will be available at https://github.com/Kingwin97.

AI.tldr: LoHGNet是一种融合洛伦兹几何编码与高阶关系学习的红外小目标检测网络，通过双曲几何特征建模和超图构建，在三个数据集上取得了优异性能。
AI.motivation: 现有IRSTD方法依赖欧氏空间特征学习，难以描述弱目标的细微差异以及目标与背景之间的上下文关系，需要新的特征表示方式来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 1) 构建洛伦兹编码分支，使用几何注意力引导的洛伦兹残差卷积模块(GA-LRCM)进行双曲几何约束下的特征建模；2) 通过对数映射将双曲特征映射到欧氏切空间；3) 设计高阶关系学习模块(HORL)，通过超图构建建模目标与背景的高阶上下文依赖关系。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上，LoHGNet在检测精度和复杂场景适应性方面均取得了具有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: LoHGNet通过引入洛伦兹几何编码提供了与传统方法不同的特征表示，为IRSTD提供了新的判别线索，有效提升了弱目标检测能力。

title: Signal Reshaping for GRPO in Weak-Feedback Agentic Code Repair
summary: Code-agent RL often receives weak feedback: rollout-time signals are reliable and executable, but capture only necessary or surface conditions for task success rather than the target semantic predicate. Using agentic compile-fix as the setting, we study signal reshaping for standard GRPO under such feedback. Our central claim is that GRPO's within-group comparison is meaningful only after three kinds of signals are reshaped: outcome rewards recover semantic ranking, process signals localize intra-trajectory credit, and rollouts from the same prompt remain execution-comparable. We operationalize these conditions with a minimal signal-reshaping construction that leaves GRPO's group-normalized advantage construction unchanged: compile-and-semantic layered rewards reshape trajectory ranking, step-level process scores outside group reward normalization reshape within-trajectory update strength, and failure-cause-aware rollout governance reshapes within-group comparability. Experiments show a clear end-to-end gain: full signal-reshaped GRPO improves strict compile-and-semantic accuracy from the base model's zero-shot $0.385$ to $0.535$. Controlled comparisons further explain the source of this gain: binary rewards remove the compile-only middle tier and degrade trajectory control; on top of layered rewards, process-score weighting further improves accuracy from $0.48$ to $0.53$ and reduces average evaluation steps from $23.50$ to $17.02$. As a boundary comparison, privileged-prompt token-level distillation mainly optimizes local distributional alignment; in long tool-use trajectories, this signal is diluted by non-critical tokens and cannot replace outcome semantics, process credit, or within-group comparability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究代码智能体强化学习中的信号重塑问题，针对GRPO算法在编译-修复场景下，提出三层信号重塑方法（语义分层奖励、步骤级过程分数、失败原因驱动的轨迹治理），将编译与语义准确率从0.385提升至0.535。
AI.motivation: 标准GRPO在代码智能体场景中使用的反馈信号（如编译成功/失败）仅反映表面条件，无法捕捉真正的语义正确性，导致奖励信号与任务目标之间存在语义鸿沟，需要信号重塑来弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 提出三层信号重塑框架：(1) 编译与语义分层奖励重塑轨迹排序；(2) 步骤级过程分数在组归一化之外重塑轨迹内更新强度；(3) 失败原因驱动的轨迹治理重塑组内可比性。整体保持GRPO的组归一化优势结构不变。
AI.result: 完整信号重塑的GRPO将严格编译与语义准确率从0.385提升至0.535。过程分数加权进一步将准确率从0.48提升至0.53，并将平均评估步骤从23.50减少至17.02。
AI.conclusion: 三层信号重塑对GRPO在代码智能体任务中至关重要：结果语义恢复排序、过程信号定位轨迹内信用、可执行轨迹保证组内可比性，三者缺一不可。token级蒸馏等方法无法替代这些信号。

title: Gradient-Based LoRA Rank Allocation Under GRPO: An Empirical Study
summary: Adaptive rank allocation for LoRA, allocating more parameters to important layers and fewer to unimportant ones, consistently improves efficiency under supervised fine-tuning (SFT). We investigate whether this success transfers to reinforcement learning, specifically Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Using gradient-magnitude profiling on Qwen 2.5 1.5B with GSM8K, we find that it does not: proportional rank allocation degrades accuracy by 4.5 points compared to uniform allocation (70.0% vs. 74.5%), despite using identical parameter budgets. We identify two mechanisms behind this failure. First, the gradient landscape under GRPO is fundamentally flatter than under SFT, the max-to-min layer importance ratio is only 2.17x, compared to >10x reported in SFT literature. All layers carry meaningful gradient signal; none are truly idle. Second, we discover a gradient amplification effect: non-uniform allocation widens the importance spread from 2.17x to 3.00x, creating a positive feedback loop where high-rank layers absorb more gradient while low-rank layers are progressively silenced. Our results suggest that gradient importance does not predict capacity requirements under RL, and that naive transfer of SFT-era rank allocation to alignment training should be avoided.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，在监督微调（SFT）中有效的自适应秩分配方法（为重要层分配更多参数）在强化学习（特别是GRPO）中反而导致性能下降4.5%。原因是GRPO下的梯度景观更平坦，且非均匀分配会引发梯度放大效应，形成正反馈循环。
AI.motivation: 研究SFT中有效的自适应秩分配方法（AdaLoRA）是否能迁移到强化学习（GRPO）中，并探究其失败原因。
AI.method: 在Qwen 2.5 1.5B模型上，使用GSM8K数据集，对比均匀秩分配与基于梯度幅度的比例秩分配在GRPO下的效果，并分析梯度景观和梯度放大效应。
AI.result: 比例秩分配在GRPO下准确率仅70.0%，低于均匀分配的74.5%；GRPO下最大/最小层重要性比仅2.17x（SFT>10x）；非均匀分配将重要性比扩大至3.00x。
AI.conclusion: 梯度重要性无法预测RL中的容量需求，SFT时代的秩分配方法不应直接迁移到对齐训练中。

title: SOM: Structured Opponent Modeling for LLM-based Agents via Structural Causal Model
summary: Accurately predicting opponents' behavior from interactions is a fundamental capability for large language model (LLM)-based agents in multi-agent and game-theoretic environments. Existing approaches often entangle opponent modeling with prediction, relying on implicit contextual reasoning and limiting adaptability in dynamic interactions. To this end, we propose Structured Opponent Modeling (SOM), a two-stage opponent modeling framework that distinctly separates opponent model construction and opponent prediction. At the construction stage, SOM employs a Structural Causal Model (SCM), a graph-based formalism for representing dependencies among variables, to capture directed links between opponents' observations and actions, yielding an explicit and structured opponent representation. At the prediction stage, the LLM performs structured reasoning along clear pathways derived from the SCM, improving both prediction accuracy and stability. Extensive experiments on diverse multi-agent benchmarks demonstrate that SOM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art LLM-based reasoning baselines, enabling more accurate and adaptable strategic decision-making in complex and dynamic multi-agent interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结构化对手建模（SOM）框架，通过结构因果模型（SCM）将对手建模与预测两个阶段分离，在多种多智能体基准上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将对手建模与预测纠缠在一起，依赖隐式上下文推理，限制了在动态交互中的适应性。
AI.method: 提出SOM两阶段框架：构建阶段使用SCM以图结构形式捕获对手观测与行动间的有向依赖关系；预测阶段LLM沿SCM导出的清晰路径进行结构化推理。
AI.result: 在多种多智能体基准上，SOM一致优于最先进的基于LLM的推理基线，预测准确性和稳定性均有提升。
AI.conclusion: SOM能够实现更准确、更自适应的战略决策，适用于复杂动态的多智能体交互场景。

title: The Proxy Presumption: From Semantic Embeddings to Valid Social Measures
summary: Natural Language Processing is rapidly evolving into a primary instrument for Computational Social Science, with researchers increasingly using embeddings to measure latent constructs such as novelty, creativity, and bias. However, this transition faces a fundamental validity challenge: the ''Proxy Presumption,'' or the reliance on geometric properties (e.g., cosine distance) as direct measures of social concepts. We argue that without explicit validation, unsupervised representations remain entangled mixtures of the target construct ($C$) and confounding attributes ($Z$) like topic, style, and authorship. To bridge the gap between semantic embeddings and valid social measures, we introduce the Construct Validity Protocol (CVP). Drawing on causal representation learning and psychometrics, the CVP offers a rigorous pipeline from conceptualization to quantitative verification. We further propose Counterfactual Neutralization, a novel method using LLMs to reduce confounding in embedding space. By providing a standardized Validity Suite -- including tests for discriminant, incremental, and predictive validity -- this work offers the community a toolkit to transform heuristic proxies into robust, scientifically defensible instruments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“代理预设”问题，即无监督嵌入的几何属性（如余弦距离）不能直接作为社会概念的测量工具，并引入构造效度协议（CVP）和反事实中和方法来提升嵌入的社会测量效度。
AI.motivation: 自然语言处理正在成为计算社会科学的重要工具，但研究者普遍使用嵌入的几何属性（如余弦距离）来测量社会概念（如新颖性、创造力、偏见），却忽略了这些嵌入可能混杂了主题、风格、作者等无关属性。作者认为，缺乏明确验证的情况下，无监督表征只是目标构造C与混淆属性Z的纠缠混合物，无法直接作为有效的社会测量指标。
AI.method: 借鉴因果表征学习和心理测量学，构建了构造效度协议（CVP），提供从概念化到定量验证的严格流程。还提出了反事实中和（Counterfactual Neutralization）方法，利用LLM减少嵌入空间中的混淆效应。最终提供标准化效度套件，包括判别效度、增量效度和预测效度测试。
AI.result: 提出了一套系统的工具箱，能够将启发式的代理指标转化为稳健、科学可辩护的测量工具，为计算社会科学研究提供方法论支撑。
AI.conclusion: 无监督嵌入不能直接作为社会概念的测量指标，需要通过构造效度协议（CVP）进行系统验证。反事实中和方法结合LLM可以有效减少嵌入空间中的混淆效应，提升测量的效度和可信度。该工作为社区提供了标准化效度套件，推动从启发式代理向科学仪器的转变。

title: CASCADE: Context-Aware Relaxation for Speculative Image Decoding
summary: Autoregressive generation is a powerful approach for high-fidelity image synthesis, but it remains computationally demanding and slow even on the most advanced accelerators. While speculative decoding has been explored to mitigate this bottleneck, existing approaches fail to achieve efficiency gains comparable to those observed in text generation. A key limitation is the target model's high uncertainty during image generation, which leads to high draft token rejection rates. In this work, we identify previously overlooked patterns in the target model's behavior that emerge naturally in tree-based speculative decoding. Specifically, we formalize two properties, semantic interchangeability and convergence, arising from the redundancies in the target model's hidden state representations. By capturing these redundancies across the depth and breadth of the predicted token tree, our method identifies principled opportunities for acceptance relaxation without requiring additional training. Additionally, we enhance standalone drafter performance by injecting the redundancy signals from the target model into drafter training with minimal modification. We evaluate our approach across multiple text-to-image models and drafter architectures. Results show that CASCADE achieves state-of-the-art speedups for drafter-based speculative decoding, with up to 3.6x acceleration, while maintaining image quality and text-prompt fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出CASCADE方法，利用树状投机解码中目标模型的语义可互换性和收敛性两种冗余模式，实现高达3.6倍的图像生成加速，同时保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: 自回归图像生成计算量大且速度慢，现有投机解码方法在图像生成中的效率远不如文本生成，主要原因是目标模型在图像生成时的不确定性导致草稿令牌拒绝率过高。
AI.method: 形式化定义了树状投机解码中目标模型的语义可互换性和收敛性两种属性，利用隐藏状态表示的冗余性实现接受松弛；同时将目标模型的冗余信号注入草稿模型训练中。
AI.result: 在多种文生图模型和草稿架构上实现了SOTA加速效果，最高达3.6倍加速，且图像质量和文本提示保真度不受影响。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用目标模型固有的冗余模式，CASCADE有效解决了图像生成中投机解码效率低下的问题，无需额外训练即可实现显著加速。

title: When Stored Evidence Stops Being Usable: Scale-Conditioned Evaluation of Agent Memory
summary: Memory-agent evaluations report fixed-snapshot accuracy or retrieval quality, but these scores do not show whether evidence remains usable as irrelevant sessions (sessions not annotated as task-relevant evidence for the query) accumulate. We present a scale-conditioned evaluation protocol for agent memory under evidence-preserving growth: for each query, task evidence is held fixed while irrelevant sessions are added. The protocol logs agent--memory trajectories and reports four diagnostics: budget-compliant reliability, tail memory-call burden, failure-regime decomposition, and the usable-scale boundary where reliability falls below the target. Applied to LongMemEval and LoCoMo across flat, planar, and hierarchical memory interfaces, the protocol shows reliability loss is not a single phenomenon. On LongMemEval, HippoRAG stays within the two-call budget but loses 16--20 percentage points in budget-compliant reliability as irrelevant sessions are added; LiCoMemory's observed failures depend strongly on the agent, with Qwen3-8B exceeding the budget while Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-235B remain reliable in the tested range. The result supports a framework for making scalable-memory claims conditional on agent, interface, scale range, and interaction budget.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种尺度条件化评估协议，用于在无关会话累积的情况下测试智能体记忆系统的可用性，发现可靠性下降并非单一现象，且与智能体、接口、尺度范围和交互预算相关。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆智能体评估仅报告固定快照下的准确率或检索质量，无法反映当无关会话（未被标注为与查询任务相关的会话）不断累积时，证据是否仍然可用。
AI.method: 提出了尺度条件化评估协议：对每个查询，固定任务证据不变，逐步添加无关会话；记录智能体-记忆轨迹，报告四个诊断指标：预算合规可靠性、尾部记忆调用负担、失败模式分解、以及可用尺度边界。
AI.result: 在LongMemEval和LoCoMo上对平面、扁平、层级三种记忆接口进行测试，发现：HippoRAG虽然保持在两调用预算内，但预算合规可靠性随无关会话增加下降16-20个百分点；LiCoMemory的失败模式强烈依赖于智能体，Qwen3-8B超出预算，而Qwen3-32B和Qwen3-235B在测试范围内保持可靠。
AI.conclusion: 可扩展记忆的结论应条件化于智能体、接口、尺度范围和交互预算四个因素。

title: Towards multi-modal forgery representation learning for AI-generated video detection and localization
summary: Recent advances in generative AI have democratized video creation at scale. AI-generated videos, including partially manipulated clips across visual and audio channels, pose escalating risks of semantic distortion and misuse, which motivates the need for reliable detection tools. Most existing AI-generated video detectors remain limited by single- or partial-modality of data modeling and the lack of fine-grained temporal forgery localization. To address these challenges, our primary novelty introduces a core architecture that jointly integrates an LMM semantic branch with a spatio-temporal (ST) visual branch and a multi-scale partial-spoof (PS) audio branch. This multi-modal approach enables simultaneous detection and fine-grained temporal localization of partially manipulated AI-generated video forgeries. Extensive experiments show that this approach outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种多模态架构，联合大语言模型语义分支、时空视觉分支和多尺度局部伪造音频分支，实现对AI生成视频的检测与细粒度时间定位。
AI.motivation: 现有AI视频检测方法局限于单模态或部分模态数据建模，缺乏细粒度的时间伪造定位能力，难以应对日益复杂的AI生成视频语义扭曲和滥用风险。
AI.method: 核心架构联合三个分支：1）LMM语义分支；2）时空（ST）视觉分支；3）多尺度局部伪造（PS）音频分支，实现多模态联合检测与细粒度时间定位。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该方法在检测性能上优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 该多模态方法能同时实现AI生成视频伪造的检测和细粒度时间定位，有效应对部分篡改场景。

title: Implicit Compression Regularization: Concise Reasoning via Internal Shorter Distributions in RL Post-Training
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves LLM reasoning but often induces overthinking, where models generate unnecessarily long reasoning traces. Existing methods mainly rely on length penalties or early-exit strategies; however, the former may degrade accuracy and induce underthinking, whereas the latter assumes that substantial portions of reasoning traces can be safely truncated. To obtain a compression signal without these limitations, we revisit the training dynamics of existing compression methods. We observe that the length--accuracy correlation is initially negative but continually increases during compression, indicating that shorter responses are initially more likely to be correct but gradually lose this property as the policy moves toward underthinking. Based on this observation, we formalize overthinking: a negative correlation indicates an overthinking regime, while a positive one indicates underthinking. When overthinking, the shortest correct responses are shorter than the group-average response length in expectation, making them natural compression targets already present in on-policy rollouts. We therefore propose \emph{Implicit Compression Regularization} (ICR), an on-policy regularization method whose compression signal comes from a virtual shorter distribution induced by the shortest correct responses in rollout groups, guiding the policy toward concise yet correct trajectories. Training dynamics show that ICR maintains a better length--accuracy correlation during compression, indicating that short responses remain better aligned with correctness instead of drifting toward underthinking. Experiments on three reasoning backbones and multiple mathematical and knowledge-intensive benchmarks show that ICR consistently shortens responses while preserving or improving accuracy, achieving a stronger accuracy--length Pareto frontier.

AI.tldr: 本文提出隐式压缩正则化（ICR）方法，通过利用同策略采样中最短正确响应作为压缩信号，在不引入长度惩罚或提前退出策略的情况下，有效缓解大语言模型推理中的过度思考问题，同时避免欠思考，实现了更好的准确率-长度帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖长度惩罚（会降低准确率并导致欠思考）或提前退出策略（假设推理轨迹可安全截断，局限性大），缺乏一种既能压缩推理长度又不损害准确性的隐式压缩信号。
AI.method: 基于长度-准确率相关性分析（负相关=过度思考，正相关=欠思考），提出ICR方法：在同策略采样组中，取最短正确响应作为虚拟更短分布，以此作为正则化信号，引导策略生成简洁而正确的推理轨迹。
AI.result: 在多个推理主干模型和数学/知识密集型基准测试上，ICR一致地缩短了响应长度，同时保持或提升了准确率，实现了更强的准确率-长度帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: ICR在压缩过程中维持了更好的长度-准确率相关性，使得短响应始终与正确性对齐，不会滑向欠思考，是一种更优的推理压缩正则化方法。

title: Hard to Read, Easy to Jailbreak: How Visual Degradation Bypasses MLLM Safety Alignment
summary: Recent advancements in visual context compression enable MLLMs to process ultra-long contexts efficiently by rendering text into images. However, we identify a critical vulnerability inherent to this paradigm: lowering image resolution inadvertently catalyzes jailbreaking. Our experiments reveal that the safety defenses of SOTA models deteriorate sharply as resolution degrades, surprisingly persisting even when text remains legible. We attribute this to ``Cognitive Overload'', hypothesizing that the effort required to decipher degraded inputs diverts attentional resources from safety auditing. This phenomenon is consistent across various visual perturbations, including noise and geometric distortion. To address this, we propose a simple ``Structured Cognitive Offloading'' strategy that mitigates these risks by enforcing a serialized pipeline to decouple visual transcription from safety assessment. Our work exposes a significant risk in vision-based compression and provides critical insights for the secure design of future MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 视觉上下文压缩技术虽然能让多模态大模型高效处理超长文本，但研究发现降低图像分辨率会意外引发“越狱”安全漏洞——模型的安全防御能力随分辨率下降而急剧退化，即便文字仍可辨识。作者将这一现象归因于“认知过载”，并提出“结构化认知卸载”策略，通过分离视觉转录与安全评估来缓解风险。
AI.motivation: 发现视觉上下文压缩范式下，降低图像分辨率会意外导致多模态大模型安全防御机制失效，揭示该范式中存在的关键安全漏洞。
AI.method: 通过系统实验验证分辨率降低对模型安全防御的影响，提出“认知过载”假说解释该现象，并设计“结构化认知卸载”策略——将视觉转录与安全评估解耦为串行流水线。
AI.result: SOTA模型的安全防御随分辨率下降急剧恶化；该现象在噪声、几何畸变等视觉扰动下一致存在；提出的结构化认知卸载策略能有效缓解风险。
AI.conclusion: 视觉上下文压缩存在被恶意利用的重大安全风险，需通过结构化的处理流程（分离转录与安全评估）来保障未来多模态大模型的安全性设计。

title: Discovering Ordinary Differential Equations with LLM-Based Qualitative and Quantitative Evaluation
summary: Discovering governing differential equations from observational data is a fundamental challenge in scientific machine learning. Existing symbolic regression approaches rely primarily on quantitative metrics; however, real-world differential equation modeling also requires incorporating domain knowledge to ensure physical plausibility. To address this gap, we propose DoLQ, a method for discovering ordinary differential equations with LLM-based qualitative and quantitative evaluation. DoLQ employs a multi-agent architecture: a Sampler Agent proposes dynamic system candidates, a Parameter Optimizer refines equations for accuracy, and a Scientist Agent leverages an LLM to conduct both qualitative and quantitative evaluations and synthesize their results to iteratively guide the search. Experiments on multi-dimensional ordinary differential equation benchmarks demonstrate that DoLQ achieves superior performance compared to existing methods, not only attaining higher success rates but also more accurately recovering the correct symbolic terms of ground truth equations. Our code is available at https://github.com/Bon99yun/DoLQ.

AI.tldr: 提出DoLQ方法，利用大语言模型进行定性与定量评估，结合多智能体架构从观测数据中发现常微分方程，在基准测试中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有符号回归方法主要依赖定量指标，但真实世界的微分方程建模还需要领域知识来确保物理合理性，现有方法缺乏对定性知识的融合。
AI.method: DoLQ采用多智能体架构：Sampler Agent提出动态系统候选，Parameter Optimizer优化方程参数，Scientist Agent利用LLM进行定性与定量评估并综合结果迭代指导搜索。
AI.result: 在多维常微分方程基准测试中，DoLQ相比现有方法取得了更高的成功率和更准确地恢复了真实方程的符号项。
AI.conclusion: 结合LLM的定性与定量评估能有效提升微分方程发现的质量和物理合理性。

title: Data Contamination in Neural Hieroglyphic Translation: A Reproducibility Study
summary: Ancient and endangered languages pose a unique challenge for NLP: their datasets are inherently scarce, difficult to expand, and built from formulaic corpora -- making data-quality issues especially consequential yet rarely audited. Motivated by the need to understand what current NMT can realistically achieve for such languages, we investigate hieroglyphic-to-German translation, where a recent study reported 61.5 BLEU using fine-tuned M2M-100. Our reproduction yields only 37.0 BLEU with the released model. Investigating this gap, we find 2\% of test targets appear identically in training (16/50; 50\% under 8-gram overlap at 70\% threshold). This contamination inflates scores dramatically: contaminated samples achieve up to 83.8 BLEU / 0.924 COMET-22 versus 30.9--39.2 BLEU / 0.622--0.676 COMET-22 on clean samples across five model configurations spanning two architectures. Document-level decontamination reduces contaminated BLEU by only 4.6 points because 8/16 targets persist via other source documents -- target-level deduplication is required. We release a decontaminated 34-sample test set and establish corrected baselines (30.9--39.2 BLEU), providing a realistic assessment of NMT capability for this endangered writing system.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现象形文字-德语神经机器翻译研究存在数据污染问题，原始报告的61.5 BLEU分数被大幅高估，实际在30.9-39.2 BLEU之间，并发布了去污染后的测试集和修正基线。
AI.motivation: 古老和濒危语言的NLP数据集稀缺且质量未被充分审计，需要理解当前NMT对此类语言的真实能力。
AI.method: 复现象形文字到德语翻译实验，分析数据污染（训练与测试集重叠），进行文档级和句子级去污染，测试五种模型配置。
AI.result: 原始报告61.5 BLEU，复现仅37.0 BLEU；发现2%测试目标与训练集相同；污染样本达83.8 BLEU，清洁样本仅30.9-39.2 BLEU；文档级去污染效果有限，需目标级去重。
AI.conclusion: 建立了对濒危书写系统NMT能力的现实评估基线，发布了34样本的去污染测试集，强调数据审计和质量控制对低资源语言研究的重要性。

title: LENS: Low-Frequency Eigen Noise Shaping for Efficient Diffusion Sampling
summary: Distilled diffusion models accelerate image generation by reducing the number of denoising steps, but often suffer from degraded image quality. To mitigate this trade-off, test-time optimization methods improve quality, yet their iterative nature incurs substantial computational overhead and leads to slow inference, limiting practical usability. Recent hypernetwork-based approaches amortize this process during training, but still require costly noise modulation in high-dimensional latent spaces. In this work, we propose LENS (Low-frequency Eigen Noise Shaping), an efficient noise modulation framework that operates in a low-dimensional subspace. Our approach is motivated by the observation that low-frequency components of the noise largely determine the global structure and visual fidelity of generated images. Based on this observation, we provide a theoretical justification for restricting modulation to the low-frequency subspace and derive a principled training objective. Building on this, LENS employs a lightweight, standalone network to selectively modulate these components, enabling efficient and targeted noise modulation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LENS achieves competitive image quality while reducing FLOPs by 400-700$\times$, model parameters by 25-75$\times$, and inference-time overhead by 10-20$\times$ compared to prior methods.

AI.tldr: 提出LENS框架，通过仅在低频特征子空间中进行噪声调制，大幅降低计算开销，在保持图像质量的同时实现400-700倍FLOPs减少。
AI.motivation: 蒸馏扩散模型加速生成时存在图像质量下降问题，现有测试时优化方法计算开销大，超网络方法仍需在高维潜在空间中进行昂贵的噪声调制。
AI.method: 基于低频噪声分量主导全局结构和视觉保真度的观察，将噪声调制限制在低频子空间，使用轻量级独立网络选择性调制这些成分。
AI.result: FLOPs降低400-700倍，模型参数减少25-75倍，推理时间开销降低10-20倍，同时保持有竞争力的图像质量。
AI.conclusion: LENS通过低频子空间噪声调制实现了高效的蒸馏扩散模型质量提升，显著降低了计算成本。

title: Tools as Continuous Flow for Evolving Agentic Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in orchestrating tools for reasoning tasks. However, existing methods rely on a step-wise paradigm that lacks a global perspective, which causes error accumulation over long horizons and restricts generalization to unseen tools. To overcome these limitations, we propose Tools as Continuous Flow for Evolving Agentic Reasoning (FlowAgent), which reconceptualizes tool chaining as continuous trajectory generation within a semantic space. To systematically evaluate this paradigm, we introduce the first plan-level closed-loop benchmark dedicated to plan-level agentic reasoning in dynamic real-world environments. Specifically, the proposed FlowAgent leverages conditional flow matching to generate continuous latent trajectories, providing a global planning perspective to ensure coherent and robust tool execution. Theoretically, we establish formal bounds on utility convergence and prove that our continuous formulation fundamentally guarantees robust generalization and error attenuation. Empirical evaluations show that FlowAgent achieves superior robustness and adaptability in long-horizon reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出FlowAgent，将工具链重构为语义空间中的连续轨迹生成，通过条件流匹配实现全局规划视角，在长时域推理任务中显著提升鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有逐步式工具编排方法缺乏全局视角，导致误差随时间累积，且难以泛化到未见过的工具。
AI.method: 利用条件流匹配在语义空间中生成连续潜在轨迹，将工具链建模为连续流，实现全局规划视角下的工具执行。
AI.result: 在长时域推理任务中展现出优越的鲁棒性和适应性，并建立了效用收敛的理论形式化边界。
AI.conclusion: 连续形式化方法从根本上保证了鲁棒泛化和误差衰减，为智能体推理提供了新的范式。

title: GRaSp: Automatic Example Optimization for In-Context Learning in Low-Data Tasks
summary: In-context learning enables large language models to adapt to new tasks, but their performance is highly sensitive to the selected examples. Finding effective demonstrations is particularly difficult in domain-specific, low-data settings where high-quality examples are scarce. We propose GRaSp, a three-stage framework for automatic in-context example optimization. By first generating a large synthetic candidate pool, then structuring it with clustering and dimensionality reduction, and finally using genetic algorithms to find the optimal in-context examples, the framework shows consistent improvements on the NER task. We also introduce a custom diversity-adaptive mutation mechanism, allowing it to transition from the initial broad inter-cluster exploration to focused intra-cluster refinement as the population converges. We evaluate GRaSp on financial named entity recognition (FiNER-139), comparing synthetic and human-annotated candidate pools across pool sizes of 500 and 5000. With non-synthetic data, GRaSp achieves 45.84% micro-F1, consistently outperforming both zero-shot and random few-shot baselines. Synthetic data matches the random baseline but does not exceed it, suggesting that distributional variety in the candidate pool is critical for generalization.

AI.tldr: GRaSp是一个三阶段框架，通过生成合成候选池、聚类降维、遗传算法优化，自动选取最优上下文示例，在金融NER任务中持续优于零样本和随机少样本基线。
AI.motivation: 大模型上下文学习性能对所选示例高度敏感，在低资源领域场景中高质量示例稀缺，亟需自动化的示例优化方法。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：(1)生成大规模合成候选池；(2)聚类与降维进行结构化；(3)遗传算法优化选取上下文示例。并引入多样性自适应变异机制，从簇间探索过渡到簇内细化。
AI.result: 在FiNER-139数据集上，使用非合成数据时GRaSp达到45.84% micro-F1，优于零样本和随机少样本基线；合成数据仅匹配随机基线，未超过。
AI.conclusion: 候选池的分布多样性对泛化至关重要；GRaSp能有效优化示例选择，但合成数据质量与真实数据仍有差距。

title: Confidence-Aware Alignment Makes Reasoning LLMs More Reliable
summary: Large reasoning models often reach correct answers through flawed intermediate steps, creating a gap between final accuracy and reasoning reliability. Existing alignment strategies address this with external verifiers or massive sampling, limiting scalability. In this work, we introduce CASPO (Confidence-Aware Step-wise Preference Optimization), a framework that aligns token-level confidence with step-wise logical correctness through iterative Direct Preference Optimization, without training a separate reward model. During inference, we propose Confidence-aware Thought (CaT), which leverages this calibrated confidence to dynamically prune uncertain reasoning branches with negligible O(V) latency. Experiments across ten benchmarks and multiple model families show that CASPO consistently improves reasoning reliability and inference efficiency. CASPO scales to Qwen3-8B-Base and surpasses tree-search baselines on AIME'24 and AIME'25 without using reward-model data. We also release a step-wise dataset with confidence annotations to support fine-grained analysis of reasoning reliability. Code is available at https://github.com/Thecommonirin/CASPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CASPO框架，通过置信度感知的逐步偏好优化对齐模型置信度与推理逻辑正确性，并利用CaT方法在推理时动态修剪不确定的推理分支，从而提升推理可靠性和效率。
AI.motivation: 大推理模型常以有缺陷的中间步骤得出正确答案，造成最终准确性与推理可靠性之间的差距；现有对齐策略依赖外部验证器或大规模采样，可扩展性受限。
AI.method: CASPO通过迭代式直接偏好优化（DPO）对齐token级置信度与逐步逻辑正确性，无需训练独立的奖励模型；推理阶段采用Confidence-aware Thought（CaT）利用校准后的置信度动态剪枝不确定的推理分支。
AI.result: 在十个基准测试和多个模型家族上，CASPO持续提升了推理可靠性和推理效率；扩展到Qwen3-8B-Base并在AIME'24和AIME'25上超越了树搜索基线，且无需使用奖励模型数据。
AI.conclusion: CASPO有效弥合了准确性与推理可靠性之间的差距，同时提升了推理效率，具有良好的可扩展性。

title: Think-with-Rubrics: From External Evaluator to Internal Reasoning Guidance
summary: Rubrics have been extensively utilized for evaluating unverifiable, open-ended tasks, with recent research incorporating them into reward systems for reinforcement learning. However, existing frameworks typically treat rubrics only as external evaluator disjointed from the policy's primary reasoning trace. Such design confines rubrics to post-hoc measurement, leaving them unable to actively guide the model's generation process. In this work, we introduce Think-with-Rubrics, a novel paradigm for instruction following tasks. Think-with-Rubrics integrates rubric generation into the reasoning context, transforming the rubric from an independent artifact into an internal guidance of LLM's generation. During training, LLM sequentially generates a rubric followed by a response, while a trained rubric verifier provides joint supervision by evaluating the consistency between the answer and the self-generated / golden rubrics. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that Think-with-Rubrics consistently outperforms the Rubric-as-Reward baseline supervised by golden rubrics by an average of 3.87 points. We have also discussed the mechanism by which Think-with-Rubrics enhances model performance. Experimental results demonstrate that supervision from golden rubrics and self-generated rubrics enhances the performance of Think-with-Rubrics by improving the quality of self-generated rubrics and increasing the internal consistency of responses respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Think-with-Rubrics范式，将评分标准（rubric）从外部评估器转变为LLM生成过程中的内部指导，通过联合训练rubric生成与答案生成，在指令跟随任务上平均提升3.87分。
AI.motivation: 现有框架将rubric视为与模型推理轨迹脱节的外部评估器，只能用于事后评估，无法主动指导模型的生成过程。
AI.method: 将rubric生成融入推理上下文，训练LLM顺序生成rubric再生成回答，同时用训练好的rubric验证器对自生成/黄金rubric与答案的一致性进行联合监督。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上，Think-with-Rubrics比基于黄金rubric的Rubric-as-Reward基线平均提升3.87分。
AI.conclusion: 黄金rubric的监督提升了自生成rubric的质量，自生成rubric的监督提升了回答的内部一致性，两者共同增强了模型性能。

title: TAS-LoRA: Transformer Architecture Search with Mixture-of-LoRA Experts
summary: Transformer architecture search (TAS) discovers optimal vision transformer (ViT) architectures automatically, reducing human effort to manually design ViTs.
