To reduce this expense, we propose VecCISC, a lightweight, adaptive framework that uses a measure of semantic similarity to filter reasoning traces that are semantically equivalent to others, degenerate, or hallucinated, thus decreasing the number of candidate answers that must be evaluated by the critic. To ensure adequate experimental thoroughness, we evaluate VecCISC on five challenging, widely-adopted datasets spanning the domains of mathematics, chemistry, biology, commonsense reasoning, and the humanities. Our results demonstrate that VecCISC reduces the total token usage by 47%, while maintaining or exceeding the accuracy of CISC.

AI.tldr: VecCISC通过语义相似性过滤冗余、退化或幻觉的推理轨迹，在保持或提升加权投票准确率的同时，将总token使用量减少47%。
AI.motivation: 加权多数投票（如CISC）虽能提升推理性能，但需要调用额外的评判LLM来为每个候选答案生成置信度分数，导致大量计算开销和成本增加。
AI.method: 提出VecCISC框架，利用语义相似性度量过滤掉语义等价、退化或包含幻觉的推理轨迹，从而减少需要评判模型评估的候选答案数量。
AI.result: 在数学、化学、生物学、常识推理和人文学科等五个挑战性数据集上，VecCISC在保持或超越CISC准确率的同时，将总token使用量减少了47%。
AI.conclusion: VecCISC是一种轻量级、自适应的框架，能够有效降低加权多数投票的计算成本，同时不牺牲推理准确性。

title: Beyond "I cannot fulfill this request": Alleviating Rigid Rejection in LLMs via Label Enhancement
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on safety alignment to obey safe requests while refusing harmful ones. However, traditional refusal mechanisms often lead to "rigid rejection," where a general template (e.g., "I cannot fulfill this request") indiscriminately triggers refusals and severely undermines the naturalness of interactions between humans and LLMs. To address this issue, LANCE is proposed in this paper to ensure safe yet flexible and natural responses via label enhancement. Specifically, LANCE employs variational inference to perform label enhancement, predicting a continuous distribution across multiple rejection categories. These fine-grained rejection distributions provide multi-way textual gradients for a refinement model to neutralize the hazardous elements in the prompt, so that the LLMs could generate safe responses that avoid rigid rejections while preserving the naturalness of interactions. Experiments demonstrate that LANCE significantly alleviates the rigid rejection problem while maintaining high security standards, significantly outperforming existing baseline models in terms of helpfulness and naturalness of responses.

AI.tldr: LANCE通过标签增强（变分推断生成连续拒绝分布）来缓解LLM的刚性拒绝问题，在保证安全性的同时提升响应的自然性与帮助性。
AI.motivation: 传统LLM的安全对齐机制使用通用拒绝模板（如"无法满足请求"），导致"刚性拒绝"问题，严重破坏了人机交互的自然性。
AI.method: 采用变分推断进行标签增强，预测多个拒绝类别的连续分布；利用细粒度的拒绝分布为精炼模型提供多维文本梯度，以中和提示中的有害元素。
AI.result: LANCE显著缓解了刚性拒绝问题，同时在帮助性和自然性方面大幅优于现有基线模型，且保持了高安全标准。
AI.conclusion: LANCE通过标签增强策略实现了安全性与交互自然性的平衡，证明了细粒度拒绝分布引导的安全响应生成是有效路径。

title: Consensus Entropy: Harnessing Multi-VLM Agreement for Self-Verifying and Self-Improving OCR
summary: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is fundamental to Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and high-quality data generation for LLM training. Yet, despite progress in average OCR accuracy, state-of-the-art VLMs still struggle with detecting sample-level errors and lack effective unsupervised quality control. We introduce Consensus Entropy (CE), a training-free, model-agnostic metric that estimates output reliability by measuring inter-model agreement entropy. The core insight is that correct predictions converge in output space, while errors diverge. Based on CE, we develop CE-OCR, a lightweight multi-model framework that verifies outputs by ensemble agreement, selects the best outputs, and further improves efficiency through adaptive routing. Experiments demonstrate that CE is robust for quality verification, improving F1 scores by 42.1% over VLM-as-Judge. CE-OCR achieves consistent OCR gains, outperforming self-consistency and single-model baselines at the same cost. Notably, CE requires no training or supervision, enabling plug-and-play integration. Code: https://github.com/Aslan-yulong/consensus-entropy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出共识熵（CE）和CE-OCR框架，通过多模型间的一致性熵来无监督地评估OCR输出可靠性，无需训练即可提升VLMs的OCR质量，F1分数相比VLM-as-Judge提升42.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有VLMs在OCR任务中虽平均准确率提升，但仍缺乏有效的无监督质量控制手段，难以检测样本级错误。
AI.method: 提出Consensus Entropy（CE）指标，通过测量多个模型输出之间的一致熵来估计可靠性；基于CE构建CE-OCR框架，包括集成验证、最优输出选择和自适应路由。
AI.result: CE在质量验证上F1分数比VLM-as-Judge提升42.1%；CE-OCR在相同成本下优于自一致性和单模型基线。
AI.conclusion: CE无需训练或监督，即插即用，为OCR质量验证提供了一种有效的无监督方法。

title: CoCoReviewBench: A Completeness- and Correctness-Oriented Benchmark for AI Reviewers
summary: Despite the rapid development of AI reviewers, evaluating such systems remains challenging: metrics favor overlap with human reviews over correctness. However, since human reviews often cover only a subset of salient issues and sometimes contain mistakes, they are unreliable as gold references. To address this, we build category-specific benchmark subsets and skip evaluation when the corresponding human reviews are missing to strengthen Completeness. We also leverage reviewer--author--meta-review discussions as expert annotations and filter unreliable reviews accordingly to strengthen Correctness. Finally, we introduce CoCoReviewBench, which curates 3,900 papers from ICLR and NeurIPS to enable reliable and fine-grained evaluation of AI reviewers. Analysis shows that AI reviewers remain limited in correctness and are prone to hallucinations, and highlights reasoning models as more effective reviewers, motivating further directions for improving AI reviewers. Benchmarks and models are available at https://github.com/hexuandeng/CoCoReviewBench.

AI.tldr: 现有AI审稿人的评估方法依赖人工评审作为黄金标准，但人工评审存在不完整和错误的问题。为此，本文构建了类别特定基准子集、利用评审-作者-元评审讨论作为专家标注，并引入CoCoReviewBench基准（包含3900篇ICLR/NeurIPS论文），实现更可靠、细粒度的AI审稿人评估。分析显示AI审稿人在正确性方面仍有局限且易产生幻觉，推理模型则表现更优。
AI.motivation: 现有评估AI审稿人的指标过于依赖与人工评审的重叠度，但人工评审本身存在覆盖不全和包含错误的问题，不适合作为黄金标准，因此需要更可靠的评估方法。
AI.method: 1）构建类别特定基准子集，在缺少对应人工评审时跳过评估以增强完整性；2）利用评审-作者-元评审讨论作为专家标注，过滤不可靠评审以增强正确性；3）构建CoCoReviewBench基准，包含3900篇ICLR/NeurIPS论文。
AI.result: AI审稿人在正确性方面仍有局限，容易产生幻觉；推理模型作为审稿人表现更有效。
AI.conclusion: 提出了更可靠的AI审稿人评估框架CoCoReviewBench，揭示了当前AI审稿人的不足，并指出了推理模型作为改进方向。

title: ForgeVLA: Federated Vision-Language-Action Learning without Language Annotations
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models hold great promise for general-purpose robotic intelligence, yet scaling up such models is severely bottlenecked by the high cost of acquiring annotated training data. Fortunately, vision-equipped robots deployed across various domains already produce abundant vision-action pairs that can be leveraged to scale up VLA training more efficiently. However, these raw data cannot be centrally aggregated due to various constraints and also exhibit severe heterogeneity. To address these challenges, in this paper, we propose ForgeVLA, a federated VLA training framework that learns VLA models from distributed vision-action pairs without centralizing raw data or requiring manual annotations. Specifically, each client in ForgeVLA is equipped with an embodied instruction classifier that maps vision-action pairs to a predefined instruction set, recovering the missing language modality and forming complete vision-language-action triplets. Beyond triplet construction, we also identify vision-language feature collapse as a critical challenge that has been largely overlooked in prior federated VLA research. To mitigate this issue, ForgeVLA combines a client-side contrastive planning loss with a server-side adaptive aggregation strategy to learn task-discriminative representations efficiently. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks show that ForgeVLA significantly outperforms other baselines, and ablation studies further validate the contribution of each component.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ForgeVLA，一种联邦式VLA训练框架，无需集中原始数据或人工标注，通过分布式视觉-动作对学习VLA模型，有效解决数据异构性和语言模态缺失问题，并缓解视觉-语言特征坍缩，实验性能显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: VLA模型的扩展受限于高质量标注数据的高成本，而广泛部署的机器人虽产生大量视觉-动作对，但数据分散且存在严重异构性，无法集中聚合，亟需一种既能保护数据隐私又能高效利用分布式数据训练VLA模型的方法。
AI.method: ForgeVLA采用联邦学习框架，每个客户端配备具身指令分类器将视觉-动作对映射到预定义指令集以恢复语言模态；同时提出客户端对比规划损失与服务器端自适应聚合策略相结合的方法，缓解视觉-语言特征坍缩，学习任务判别性表示。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上的大量实验表明，ForgeVLA显著优于其他基线方法，消融实验进一步验证了各组成部分的贡献。
AI.conclusion: ForgeVLA为在隐私保护和数据异构条件下高效扩展VLA模型训练提供了可行方案，通过联邦学习框架和特征坍缩缓解机制，实现了无需集中数据和人工标注的VLA模型学习。

title: How Value Induction Reshapes LLM Behaviour
summary: Conversational Large Language Models are post-trained on language that expresses specific behavioural traits, such as curiosity, open-mindedness, and empathy, and values, such as helpfulness, harmlessness, and honesty. This is done to increase utility, ensure safety, and improve the experience of the people interacting with the model. However, values are complex and inter-related -- inducing one could modify behaviour on another. Further, inducing certain values can make models more addictive or sycophantic through language used in the generations, with a potential detrimental effect on the user. We investigate these and other unintended effects of value induction into models. We fine-tune models using curated value subsets of existing preference datasets, measuring the impact of value induction on expression of other values, model safety, anthropomorphic language, and various QA benchmarks. We find that (i) inducing values leads to expression of other related, and sometimes contrastive values, (ii) inducing positive values increases safety, and (iii) all values increase anthropomorphic language use, making models more validating and sycophantic.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了在对话大语言模型中诱导特定价值观（如好奇心、同理心等）的意外后果，发现价值观诱导会导致其他相关或对立价值观的表达、提升安全性，但也会增加拟人化语言使用，使模型更具验证性和谄媚性。
AI.motivation: 对话大语言模型通过后训练植入特定行为特质和价值观（如有用性、无害性、诚实性）来提升效用和安全性，但价值观之间相互关联且复杂，诱导某一价值观可能影响其他价值观的表现，甚至可能导致模型成瘾性或谄媚倾向，对用户产生潜在负面影响。作者希望探究这些非预期效应。
AI.method: 使用现有偏好数据集的价值观子集对模型进行微调，测量价值观诱导对其他价值观表达、模型安全性、拟人化语言以及各类问答基准测试的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现：（i）诱导某一价值观会导致其他相关甚至对立价值观的表达；（ii）诱导积极价值观会提升模型安全性；（iii）所有价值观都会增加拟人化语言使用，使模型更具验证性和谄媚性。
AI.conclusion: 价值观诱导存在非预期效应，虽然能提升安全性和相关价值观表达，但会带来拟人化和谄媚性增加的副作用，需要在模型对齐中加以关注和平衡。

title: ReasonEdit: Towards Interpretable Image Editing Evaluation via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Recent text-guided image editing (TIE) models have achieved remarkable progress, however, many edited results still suffer from artifacts, unintended modifications, and suboptimal aesthetics. Although several benchmarks and evaluation methods have been proposed, most existing approaches rely on scalar scores and lack interpretability. This limitation largely stems from the absence of high-quality interpretation datasets for TIE and effective reward models to train interpretable evaluators. To address these challenges, we introduce ReasonEdit-22K, the first dataset that combines 22K edited images with 113K Chain-of-Thought (CoT) samples, along with 1.3M human judgments assessing these interpretations in terms of logicality, accuracy, and usefulness. Building upon this dataset, we propose RE-Reward, a multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based reward model designed to provide human-aligned feedback for evaluating interpretable reasoning in image editing. Furthermore, we develop ReasonEdit, which is trained using reward signals derived from RE-Reward and the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) algorithm to learn an interpretable evaluation model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReasonEdit achieves superior alignment with human preferences and exhibits strong generalization across public benchmarks. In addition, it is capable of generating high-quality interpretable evaluation text, enabling more transparent and trustworthy assessment for image editing. The code is available at https://github.com/IntMeGroup/ReasonEdit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ReasonEdit-22K数据集（含22K张编辑图像、113K条思维链样本和130万条人工评估），并基于此构建了RE-Reward奖励模型和ReasonEdit可解释评估模型，通过GRPO算法训练，实现了对文本引导图像编辑结果的高质量可解释评估，在人类偏好对齐和泛化性上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有文本引导图像编辑评估方法依赖标量分数且缺乏可解释性，根本原因在于缺少高质量的TIE可解释数据集和有效的奖励模型来训练可解释评估器。
AI.method: 1) 构建ReasonEdit-22K数据集，包含22K编辑图像、113K思维链样本和130万人类判断；2) 提出RE-Reward，基于多模态大语言模型的奖励模型，为可解释推理提供人类对齐的反馈；3) 利用GRPO算法训练ReasonEdit，学习可解释评估模型。
AI.result: ReasonEdit在人类偏好对齐和公开基准泛化性上均表现出色，能够生成高质量的可解释评估文本。
AI.conclusion: ReasonEdit为图像编辑提供了更透明、可信的评估方式，代码已开源。

title: How to Train Your Latent Diffusion Language Model Jointly With the Latent Space
summary: Latent diffusion models offer an attractive alternative to discrete diffusion for non-autoregressive text generation by operating on continuous text representations and denoising entire sequences in parallel. The major challenge in latent diffusion modeling is constructing a suitable latent space. In this work, we present the Latent Diffusion Language Model (LDLM), in which the latent encoder, diffusion model, and decoder are trained jointly. LDLM builds its latent space by reshaping the representations of a pre-trained language model with a trainable encoder, yielding latents that are easy to both denoise and decode into tokens. We show that naive joint training produces a low-quality diffusion model, and propose a simple training recipe consisting of an MSE decoder loss, diffusion-to-encoder warmup, adaptive timestep sampling, and decoder-input noise. Ablations show that each component substantially impacts generation performance. On OpenWebText and LM1B, LDLM achieves better generation performance than existing discrete and continuous diffusion language models while being $2{\text -}13\times$ faster, indicating that jointly learning the latent space is a key step toward making latent diffusion competitive for text generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LDLM（Latent Diffusion Language Model），通过联合训练潜在编码器、扩散模型和解码器，构建适合文本生成的潜在空间，在OpenWebText和LM1B上取得优于现有离散/连续扩散语言模型的生成性能，且速度快2-13倍。
AI.motivation: 潜在扩散模型在连续文本表示上并行去噪，是非自回归文本生成的有吸引力的替代方案，但构建合适的潜在空间是主要挑战。现有方法难以同时兼顾去噪容易性和解码准确性。
AI.method: 提出LDLM，联合训练潜在编码器、扩散模型和解码器；通过重塑预训练语言模型的表示来构建潜在空间；提出包括MSE解码器损失、扩散到编码器的预热、自适应时间步采样和解码器输入噪声的训练策略。
AI.result: 在OpenWebText和LM1B上，LDLM的生成性能优于现有离散和连续扩散语言模型，同时推理速度快2-13倍。
AI.conclusion: 联合学习潜在空间是使潜在扩散在文本生成中具有竞争力的关键步骤。

title: Ask Early, Ask Late, Ask Right: When Does Clarification Timing Matter for Long-Horizon Agents?
summary: Long-horizon AI agents execute complex workflows spanning hundreds of sequential actions, yet a single wrong assumption early on can cascade into irreversible errors. When instructions are incomplete, the agent must decide not only whether to ask for clarification but when, and no prior work measures how clarification value changes over the course of execution. We introduce a forced-injection framework that provides ground-truth clarifications at controlled points in the agent's trajectory across four information dimensions (goal, input, constraint, context), three agent benchmarks, and four frontier models (three per benchmark; one on a single benchmark only; 84 task variants; 6,000+ runs). Counter to the common intuition that "earlier is always better," we find that the value of clarification depends sharply on what information is missing: goal clarification loses nearly all value after 10% of execution (pass@3 drops from 0.78 to baseline), while input clarification retains value through roughly 50%. Deferring any clarification type past mid-trajectory degrades performance below never asking at all. Cross-model Kendall tau correlations (0.78-0.87 among models sharing identical task coverage; 0.34-0.67 across the full 4-model panel) confirm these timing profiles are substantially task-intrinsic. A complementary study of 300 unscripted sessions reveals that no current frontier model asks within the empirically optimal window, with strategies ranging from over-asking (52% of sessions) to never asking at all. These empirical demand curves provide the quantitative foundation that existing theoretical frameworks require but have lacked, and establish concrete design targets for timing-aware clarification policies. Code and data will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了长程AI智能体在执行任务时，不同时间点获取澄清信息的效果差异。通过强制注入框架在四个信息维度上测试，发现澄清价值取决于信息类型：目标澄清在10%执行后几乎失效，输入澄清可维持至50%。所有澄清类型在中途之后询问效果还不如不问。跨模型相关性表明时间特征本质上是任务内在的。补充实验显示现有前沿模型均未在最优时间窗口内主动提问。
AI.motivation: 长程AI智能体在执行数百步复杂任务时，早期的一个错误假设可能级联为不可逆错误。当指令不完整时，智能体不仅要决定是否询问澄清，还要决定何时询问，而此前没有任何工作衡量澄清价值在执行过程中的变化规律。
AI.method: 提出强制注入框架，在智能体轨迹的受控时间点提供真实澄清信息，覆盖四个信息维度（目标、输入、约束、上下文），在三个智能体基准、四个前沿模型（共84个任务变体，6000+次运行）上进行实验。同时进行了300次非脚本会话的补充研究。
AI.result: 目标澄清在10%执行后价值几乎归零（pass@3从0.78降至基线），输入澄清可维持至约50%。任何澄清类型在中途之后询问效果不如从不询问。跨模型Kendall tau相关性（相同任务覆盖模型间0.78-0.87，全模型面板0.34-0.67）证实时间特征本质上是任务内在的。现有前沿模型从未在最优时间窗口内提问，策略从过度提问（52%）到从不提问不等。
AI.conclusion: 这些经验需求曲线为现有理论框架提供了定量基础，并为时间感知的澄清策略建立了具体的设计目标。

title: Implicit Multi-Camera System Calibration Using Gaussian Processes
summary: This paper proposes a novel framework for implicit multi-camera system calibration utilizing Gaussian Process (GP) regression. Conventional explicit calibration methods are constrained by rigid mathematical models and struggle with complex, non-linear distortions from unconventional optics, while existing neural network-based implicit approaches are typically data-hungry and lack inherent uncertainty quantification (UQ). Our GP-based model directly learns the complex, non-linear mapping from 2D image coordinates across all cameras to a 3D world coordinate, completely bypassing time-consuming estimation of explicit intrinsic and extrinsic parameters. Moreover, the inherent UQ is critical for transforming a simple 3D point prediction into a verifiable 3D measurement, complete with statistically-sound confidence bounds. To further enhance data efficiency and practical deployment, we integrate Active Learning (AL), which intelligently leverages the GP's predictive uncertainty to strategically guide the acquisition of new calibration data. This approach results in a robust, data-efficient, and reliable calibration solution, proving particularly effective in practical scenarios where collecting extensive calibration data is a dominant constraint. Our experiments show that the uncertainty for the 3D predictions is higher closer to the cameras. The data points in $uv$-coordinate space are more sparse in that region, even though they are not in 3D space. This work is relevant for anyone who is tasked with the calibration of complex multi-camera systems.

AI.tldr: 提出基于高斯过程回归的隐式多相机系统标定框架，结合主动学习实现数据高效的3D坐标映射，并自带不确定性量化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统显式标定方法受刚性数学模型限制，难以处理非常规光学引起的复杂非线性畸变；现有基于神经网络的隐式方法数据需求大且缺乏内在的不确定性量化。
AI.method: 利用高斯过程回归直接学习从2D图像坐标到3D世界坐标的复杂非线性映射，跳过显式内外参估计；集成主动学习，基于预测不确定性智能引导新标定数据的采集。
AI.result: 3D预测的不确定性在靠近相机区域更高，因为该区域在uv坐标空间中数据点更稀疏（尽管在3D空间中并不稀疏）。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了一种鲁棒、数据高效且可靠的标定解决方案，特别适用于标定数据采集受限的实际场景，通过不确定性量化将简单3D点预测转化为可验证的3D测量。

title: GLiGuard: Schema-Conditioned Classification for LLM Safeguard
summary: Ensuring safe, policy-compliant outputs from large language models requires real-time content moderation that can scale across multiple safety dimensions. However, state-of-the-art guardrail models rely on autoregressive decoders with 7B--27B parameters, reformulating what is fundamentally a classification problem as sequential text generation, a design choice that incurs high latency and scales poorly to multi-aspect evaluation. In this work, we introduce \textbf{GLiGuard}, a 0.3B-parameter schema-conditioned bidirectional encoder adapted from GLiNER2 for LLM content moderation. The key idea is to encode task definitions and label semantics directly into the input sequence as structured token schemas, enabling simultaneous evaluation of prompt safety, response safety, refusal detection, 14 fine-grained harm categories, and 11 jailbreak strategies in a single non-autoregressive forward pass. This schema-conditioned design lets supported task and label blocks be composed directly in the input schema at inference time. Across nine established safety benchmarks, GLiGuard achieves F1 scores competitive with 7B--27B decoder-based guards despite being 23--90$\times$ smaller, while delivering up to 16$\times$ higher throughput and 17$\times$ lower latency. These results suggest that compact bidirectional encoders can approach the accuracy of much larger guard models while drastically reducing inference cost. Code and models are available at https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiGuard.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GLiGuard，一个仅0.3B参数的架构条件双向编码器，用于LLM内容审核。它通过结构化token模式将任务定义和标签语义编码到输入序列中，在单次非自回归前向传播中同时评估提示安全性、响应安全性、拒绝检测、14种细粒度危害类别和11种越狱策略。在9个安全基准测试中，GLiGuard在F1分数上与7B-27B的解码器防护模型竞争，同时吞吐量提升16倍，延迟降低17倍。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型内容审核方法使用7B-27B参数的自回归解码器，将分类问题转化为序列生成任务，导致高延迟且在多方评估时扩展性差。
AI.method: 采用来自GLiNER2的0.3B参数架构条件双向编码器，将任务定义和标签语义作为结构化token模式编码到输入序列中，支持在推理时直接在输入模式中组合任务和标签块，实现单次非自回归前向传播的多方评估。
AI.result: 在9个安全基准上，F1分数与7B-27B解码器防护模型相当；吞吐量提升高达16倍，延迟降低17倍；模型体积小23-90倍。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑型双向编码器可以在大幅降低推理成本的同时，接近更大防护模型的准确性。

title: How Far Is Document Parsing from Solved? PureDocBench: A Source-TraceableBenchmark across Clean, Degraded, and Real-World Settings
summary: The past year has seen over 20 open-source document parsing models, yet thefield still benchmarks almost exclusively on OmniDocBench, a 1,355-pagemanually annotated dataset whose top scores have saturated above 90%. Athree-stage audit pipeline we run on OmniDocBench screens its 21,353evaluator-scored blocks and confirms 2,580 errors (12.08%); combined with overa year of public availability, both annotation quality and contamination riskcall its rankings into question. To address these issues, we presentPureDocBench, a programmatically generated, source-traceable benchmark thatrenders document images from HTML/CSS and produces verifiable annotations fromthe same source, covering 10 domains, 66 subcategories, and 1,475 pages, eachin three versions: clean, digitally degraded, and real-degraded (4,425 imagestotal). Evaluating 40 models spanning pipeline specialists, end-to-endspecialists, and general-purpose VLMs, we find: (i) document parsing is farfrom solved: the best model scores only ~74 out of 100, with a 44.6-point gapbetween the strongest and weakest models; (ii) specialist parsers with <=4Bparameters rival or surpass general VLMs that are 5-100x larger, yet formularecognition remains a shared bottleneck where no model exceeds 67% whenaveraging the formula metric across all three tracks; (iii) general VLMs loseonly 0.99/8.52 Overall points under digital/real degradation versus 4.90/14.21for pipeline specialists, producing ranking reversals that make clean-onlyevaluation misleading for deployment. All data, code, and artifacts arepublicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PureDocBench，一个程序化生成的文档解析基准，解决了现有标杆OmniDocBench存在的标注质量问题和污染风险。实验表明文档解析远未解决（最佳模型仅约74分），小参数专用模型可媲美大模型，但公式识别是共同瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有文档解析标杆OmniDocBench存在两个严重问题：(1) 通过三阶段审计发现12.08%的标注错误；(2) 公开时间过长导致污染风险。这使得排行榜排名不可靠，需要一个新的、可追溯的基准来重新评估模型能力。
AI.method: 提出PureDocBench基准，其核心创新是程序化生成：从HTML/CSS源渲染文档图像，并直接从同一源生成可验证的标注。覆盖10个领域、66个子类别、1475页，每页分为三个版本（干净、数字退化、真实退化），共4425张图像。评估了40个模型，包括pipeline专家、端到端专家和通用VLMs。
AI.result: (1) 最佳模型仅约74分，最强与最弱模型差距达44.6分；(2) ≤4B参数的专用解析器可媲美或超越大5-100倍的通用VLM，但公式识别是共同瓶颈（所有模型平均不超过67%）；(3) 通用VLM在退化条件下表现更稳健（损失0.99/8.52分），而pipeline专家下降更严重（4.90/14.21分），导致排名反转。
AI.conclusion: 文档解析任务远未解决，需要更可靠的基准。PureDocBench提供了可追溯、程序化生成的评估方案，揭示了当前模型的真实性能差距和退化条件下的排名变化，为实际部署提供了更有价值的参考。

title: Tool Calling is Linearly Readable and Steerable in Language Models
comment: 29 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Manuscript under review
summary: When a tool-calling agent picks the wrong tool, the failure is invisible until execution: the email gets sent, the meeting gets missed. Probing 12 instruction-tuned models across Gemma 3, Qwen 3, Qwen 2.5, and Llama 3.1 (270M to 27B), we find the identity of the chosen tool is linearly readable and steerable inside the model. Adding the mean-difference between two tools' average internal activations switches which tool the model selects at 77-100% accuracy on name-only single-turn prompts (93-100% at 4B+), and the JSON arguments that follow autoregressively match the new tool's schema, so flipping the name is enough. The same per-tool means also flag likely errors before they happen: on Gemma 3 12B and 27B, queries where the gap between the top-1 and top-2 tool is smallest produce 14-21x more wrong calls than queries with the largest gap. The causal effect concentrates along one direction, the row of the output layer that produces the target tool's first token: a unit vector along it at matched magnitude already reaches 93-100%, while what is left over leaves the choice almost untouched. Activation patching localises this to a small set of mid- and late-layer attention heads, and a within-topic probe across 14 same-domain $τ$-bench airline tools reaches top-1 61-89% across five 4B-14B models, ruling out the reading that we are just moving the model along a topic axis. Even base models encode the right tool before they can emit it: cosine readout from the internal state recovers 69-82% on BFCL while base generation reaches only 2-10%, suggesting pretraining forms the representation and instruction tuning later wires it to the output. We measure tool identity selection and JSON schema correctness in single-turn fixed-menu settings; multi-turn agentic transfer is more fragile and is discussed in Limitations.

AI.tldr: 工具选择错误在模型内部状态中可线性读取和操控，通过激活均值差异可切换工具选择（77-100%准确率），且错误可通过工具间激活差距提前检测。该效应集中在输出层特定方向，基础模型在预训练阶段就已编码正确工具表征。
AI.motivation: 工具调用智能体选错工具时，错误只在执行后才可见，缺乏事前检测手段，因此希望探究模型内部状态是否隐含工具选择信息。
AI.method: 对12个指令微调模型进行探针分析，使用均值差异激活干预切换工具选择，测量工具间激活差距与错误率的关联，并通过激活修补定位关键注意力头。
AI.result: 工具身份在线性可读且可操控，切换准确率77-100%（4B+模型达93-100%）；工具间激活差距最小的查询错误率高出14-21倍；基础模型内部表征恢复69-82%但生成仅2-10%。
AI.conclusion: 工具选择信息在模型内部以线性方式编码，预训练已形成表征，指令微调将其连接到输出层；通过内部状态可提前检测和纠正工具选择错误。

title: DIMoE-Adapters: Dynamic Expert Evolution for Continual Learning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Continual learning enables vision-language models to accumulate knowledge and adapt to evolving tasks without retraining from scratch. However, in multi-domain task-incremental learning, large domain shifts intensify the stability-plasticity dilemma. Most existing methods rely on fixed architectures with statically allocated parameters, which limits adaptation to new domains and aggravates catastrophic forgetting. To address these challenges, we propose DIMoE-Adapters, a Dynamic Incremental Mixture-of-Experts Adapters framework that introduces a dynamic expert evolution paradigm to balance stability and plasticity. This paradigm is implemented through two collaborative components: Self-Calibrated Expert Evolution (SCEE) and Prototype-Guided Expert Selection (PGES). SCEE constructs and evolves a sparse expert pool through expert optimization dynamics, improving plasticity while reducing redundant capacity. PGES controls expert utilization based on the pool shaped by SCEE, improving stability across both previously encountered and unseen tasks. Extensive experiments show that DIMoE-Adapters outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods across various settings.

AI.tldr: 提出了DIMoE-Adapters框架，通过动态专家进化范式（SCEE+PGES）解决视觉语言模型在多领域任务增量学习中的稳定性-可塑性困境。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖固定架构和静态参数分配，在新领域适应能力有限且加剧灾难性遗忘，无法有效平衡稳定性与可塑性。
AI.method: 提出DIMoE-Adapters框架，包含两个组件：自校准专家进化（SCEE）通过专家优化动力学构建并演化稀疏专家池以提升可塑性；原型引导专家选择（PGES）基于SCEE塑造的池控制专家利用率以提升稳定性。
AI.result: 在各种设置下，DIMoE-Adapters均优于以往最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 动态专家进化范式有效缓解了稳定性-可塑性困境，实现了更好的持续学习性能。

title: Fast Byte Latent Transformer
summary: Recent byte-level language models (LMs) match the performance of token-level models without relying on subword vocabularies, yet their utility is limited by slow, byte-by-byte autoregressive generation. We address this bottleneck in the Byte Latent Transformer (BLT) through new training and generation techniques. First, we introduce BLT Diffusion (BLT-D), a new model and our fastest BLT variant, trained with an auxiliary block-wise diffusion objective alongside the standard next-byte prediction loss. This enables an inference procedure that generates multiple bytes in parallel per decoding step, substantially reducing the number of forward passes required to generate a sequence. Second, we propose two extensions inspired by speculative decoding that trade some of this speed for higher generation quality: BLT Self-speculation (BLT-S), in which BLT's local decoder continues generating past its normal patch boundaries to draft bytes, which are then verified with a single full-model forward pass; and BLT Diffusion+Verification (BLT-DV), which augments BLT-D with an autoregressive verification step after diffusion-based generation. All methods may achieve an estimated memory-bandwidth cost over 50% lower than BLT on generation tasks. Each approach offers its own unique advantages, together removing key barriers to the practical use of byte-level LMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出字节潜变量变换器（BLT）的三种变体（BLT-D、BLT-S、BLT-DV），通过并行生成、推测解码等技术大幅提升字节级语言模型的生成速度，同时保持生成质量，将生成内存带宽成本降低50%以上。
AI.motivation: 字节级语言模型虽无需子词词表且性能媲美词元级模型，但逐字节自回归生成速度极慢，严重限制了其实际应用。
AI.method: 1) BLT-D：引入辅助的块级扩散目标，使模型每步并行生成多个字节；2) BLT-S：让局部解码器超越正常边界继续生成草稿字节，再通过完整模型前向验证；3) BLT-DV：在扩散生成后增加自回归验证步骤。
AI.result: 所有方法在生成任务上的估计内存带宽成本比原始BLT降低50%以上，大幅减少了生成序列所需的前向传播次数。
AI.conclusion: 三种方法各有优势，共同消除了字节级语言模型实际应用的关键障碍，为高效字节级生成提供了可行方案。

title: Lightweight Unpaired Smartphone ISP Transfer with Semantic Pseudo-Pairing
summary: Unpaired smartphone ISP is a challenging problem due to the lack of scene and color alignment between RAW and target RGB images. Many existing methods either require paired data or rely heavily on adversarial training, which can become unstable in the unpaired setting. In this work, we present a simple and effective approach developed for the NTIRE 2026 Learned Smartphone ISP Challenge with Unpaired Data. Our method first reconstructs larger images from training patches to recover global context. Then, we extract semantic embeddings with DINOv2, and use fused Gromov-Wasserstein (FGW) optimal transport to build pseudo pairs between RAW and RGB images at both image and patch levels. This semantic matching allows us to partially alleviate the unpairedness of the data and build these pseudo input-target pairs. Based on these pseudo pairs, we train a lightweight CNN with only 7K parameters for color rendering. The network is designed to be compact and focus on color transformation rather than structural change, which helps reduce artifacts and improve training stability. Our challenge submission achieves 22.569 PSNR, 0.675 SSIM, and 8.067 $ΔE$ on the final hidden test set, significantly improving over the baseline and achieving the 3rd best SSIM and $ΔE$ among all challenge entries. Our code is available at github.com/nuniniyujin/Unpaired-ISP .

AI.tldr: 本文针对无配对数据的智能手机ISP问题，提出了一种结合DINOv2语义嵌入和融合Gromov-Wasserstein最优传输的伪配对方法。通过构建RAW与RGB图像之间的伪配对，训练了一个仅7K参数的轻量级CNN进行色彩渲染，在NTIRE 2026挑战赛中取得了22.569 PSNR、0.675 SSIM和8.067 ΔE的成绩，SSIM和ΔE排名第三。
AI.motivation: 无配对智能手机ISP问题中，RAW与目标RGB图像缺乏场景和颜色对齐，现有方法依赖配对数据或对抗训练，在无配对场景下不稳定。作者旨在开发一种简单有效的无需配对数据的方法。
AI.method: 1. 重构大图恢复全局上下文；2. 使用DINOv2提取语义嵌入；3. 利用融合Gromov-Wasserstein最优传播在图像和patch层面构建RAW与RGB的伪配对；4. 基于伪配对训练仅7K参数的轻量级CNN，专注于颜色变换而非结构变化。
AI.result: 在NTIRE 2026挑战赛隐藏测试集上达到22.569 PSNR、0.675 SSIM、8.067 ΔE，相比基线显著提升，SSIM和ΔE在所有参赛作品中排名第三。
AI.conclusion: 提出的伪配对策略能有效缓解无配对数据的挑战，轻量级网络设计在保持训练稳定性的同时取得了优异性能。

title: Cloud-top infrared observations reveal the four-dimensional precipitation structure
summary: Accurate four-dimensional (4D) precipitation information is essential for understanding the Earth's energy and water cycles, yet remains observationally unresolved at global scales. Conventional theory holds that geostationary infrared observations primarily sense cloud-top properties, with limited sensitivity to sub-cloud precipitation. Here we show that cloud-top infrared measurements nevertheless encode sufficient information to recover the four-dimensional structure of precipitation, revealing a previously unexploited observability of sub-cloud processes. We introduce a physically constrained deep learning framework, 4DPrecipNet, in which a moisture-first constraint requires the latent representation to recover precipitable water vapour, anchoring the model in thermodynamic consistency. By integrating multi-channel infrared radiances with these constraints and radar-derived precipitation profiles, we reconstruct the vertical and temporal evolution of precipitation systems from geostationary orbit. The framework captures deep convective structures and their evolution, with robust performance across large samples and independent radar comparisons. These results demonstrate that sub-cloud precipitation is physically encoded in cloud-top infrared observations, establishing a new pathway for continuous global monitoring of precipitation structure.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出4DPrecipNet框架，利用云顶红外观测数据结合物理约束深度学习，成功实现了从静止轨道卫星反演降水的四维结构，揭示了云顶红外观测中编码了次云降水信息的物理特性。
AI.motivation: 全球尺度上缺乏高精度四维降水信息，而传统理论认为静止轨道红外观测主要感知云顶特性，对次云降水敏感性有限，因此需要探索从现有观测数据中挖掘更多降水信息的方法。
AI.method: 提出物理约束的深度学习框架4DPrecipNet，其中"水分优先"约束要求潜在表示恢复可降水量水汽，通过整合多通道红外辐射、物理约束和雷达降水廓线，从静止轨道遥感数据重建降水的垂直和时间演化。
AI.result: 框架成功捕捉深对流结构及其演化过程，在大样本和独立雷达对比中表现出稳健性能，证明次云降水信息物理编码于云顶红外观测中。
AI.conclusion: 云顶红外观测编码了足够的次云降水信息，为建立连续的全球降水结构监测提供了新途径。

title: Accurate and Efficient Statistical Testing for Word Semantic Breadth
summary: Measuring the breadth of a word's meaning, or its spread across contexts, has become feasible with contextualized token embeddings. A word type can be represented as a cloud of token vectors, with dispersion-based statistics serving as proxies for contextual diversity (Nagata and Tanaka-Ishii, ACL2025). These measurements are useful for deciding appropriate sense distinctions when constructing thesauri and domain-specific dictionaries. However, when comparing the breadth of two word types, naive hypothesis testing on dispersion can be misleading: differences in semantic direction can masquerade as dispersion differences, inflating Type-I error and yielding "statistically significant" outcomes even when there is no true breadth difference. This is problematic because significance testing should distinguish genuine effects from incidental fluctuations in small-difference regimes. We propose a Householder-aligned permutation test to isolate dispersion differences from directional differences. Our method applies a single Householder reflection to align the mean directions of the two word types and then performs a permutation test on the aligned token clouds, yielding calibrated, non-parametric p-values. For practicality, we introduce a GPU-oriented implementation that batches permutations and linear algebra operations. Empirically, our alignment reduced Type-I error by 32.5% while preserving sensitivity to genuine breadth differences, and achieved a 23x speedup over the CPU baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种Householder对齐置换检验方法，用于消除词义广度比较中因语义方向差异导致的假阳性错误，并实现了GPU加速。
AI.motivation: 在比较两个词类型的语义广度（上下文多样性）时，传统的离散度假设检验容易将语义方向差异误判为广度差异，导致I型错误率升高。需要一种能够区分真正广度差异与方向差异的统计检验方法。
AI.method: 提出Householder对齐置换检验：先通过Householder反射将两个词类型的均值方向对齐，然后在对齐后的词向量云上进行置换检验，得到校准的非参数p值。同时实现了GPU批处理版本以加速计算。
AI.result: 对齐方法将I型错误率降低了32.5%，同时保持了对真实广度差异的敏感性；GPU实现相比CPU基线取得了23倍的加速。
AI.conclusion: Householder对齐置换检验能有效区分语义方向差异与广度差异，为词义多样性比较提供了更可靠的统计检验工具。

title: Diffusion-APO: Trajectory-Aware Direct Preference Alignment for Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Efficiently aligning large-scale video diffusion models with human intent requires a scalable and trajectory-aware pathway that bridges the inherent discrepancy between training noise distributions and practical inference trajectories. While existing paradigms such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) attempt to address this, they are often hindered by either reliance on bias-prone, complex reward models or suboptimal timestep sampling. In this paper, we propose Diffusion-APO (Aligned Preference Optimization), a trajectory-aware algorithm that resolves this misalignment by synchronizing training noise with inference-time denoising paths to maximize gradient signal efficacy. To translate this algorithmic innovation into a practical solution, we introduce a unified and modular RLHF framework that integrates online ranking, half-online anchoring, offline refinement, and distillation-aware drift correction. This framework enables flexible, multi-stage preference alignment across diverse data and computational constraints without relying on scalar-reward-based policy gradients. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that Diffusion-APO consistently outperforms standard baselines in visual quality and instruction following, while effectively preserving generative fidelity during model acceleration, providing a robust, end-to-end pathway for scalable video diffusion alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Diffusion-APO算法，通过同步训练噪声与推理去噪路径来弥合视频扩散模型中的训练-推理差异，并设计了一个统一模块化的RLHF框架，在不依赖标量奖励策略梯度的情况下实现多阶段偏好对齐，显著提升视觉质量和指令遵循能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视频扩散模型的对齐方法（如DPO、GRPO）存在奖励模型偏差或时间步采样次优等问题，导致训练噪声分布与推理轨迹之间存在固有差异，无法高效对齐人类意图。
AI.method: 提出Diffusion-APO轨迹感知算法，同步训练噪声与推理去噪路径以最大化梯度信号效率；并设计统一模块化RLHF框架，集成在线排序、半在线锚定、离线精炼和蒸馏感知漂移校正四种策略，实现灵活的多阶段偏好对齐。
AI.result: 实验表明Diffusion-APO在视觉质量和指令遵循方面持续优于标准基线，并在模型加速过程中有效保持生成保真度。
AI.conclusion: Diffusion-APO提供了一种鲁棒、端到端的可扩展视频扩散对齐路径，无需依赖基于标量奖励的策略梯度，为大规模视频扩散模型与人类意图对齐提供了有效解决方案。

title: CA-SQL: Complexity-Aware Inference Time Reasoning for Text-to-SQL via Exploration and Compute Budget Allocation
summary: While recent advancements in inference-time learning have improved LLM reasoning on Text-to-SQL tasks, current solutions still struggle to perform well on the most challenging tasks in the Bird-Bench (BIRD) benchmark. This is due to inadequate solution space exploration, which is necessary to uncover promising candidate queries that can be further refined to produce the correct output. To address this challenge, we introduce CA-SQL, a novel Text-to-SQL pipeline that utilizes the estimated difficulty of a task to dynamically scale the breadth of the exploration for generating solution candidates. In addition, we use a custom prompt seeding method, based on principles of evolutionary search, to further elicit exploratory behavior from the base LLM and a novel voting method to select the best candidate solution at the end of the search. Experiments demonstrate that our solution achieves a state-of-the-art score of 51.72% on the "challenging" tier of BIRD development set problems, using only GPT-4o-mini, out-performing other in-context learning approaches, even those that leverage larger models. Overall, our method attains a competitive 61.06% execution accuracy and 68.77% Soft F1 score on the BIRD development dataset.

AI.tldr: CA-SQL提出了一种基于任务难度动态调整搜索广度的方法，结合进化搜索的提示播种和新型投票机制，在BIRD基准的困难任务上使用GPT-4o-mini达到了SOTA性能（51.72%），整体执行准确率61.06%。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL方法在BIRD基准的最困难任务上表现不佳，原因是解空间探索不充分，难以找到可进一步优化的候选查询。
AI.method: 1) 根据任务预估难度动态扩展候选解生成的探索广度；2) 基于进化搜索原理的自定义提示播种方法增强基础LLM的探索行为；3) 新型投票方法筛选最佳候选解。
AI.result: 在BIRD开发集的"困难"级别上达到51.72%（SOTA），仅用GPT-4o-mini即超越其他上下文学习方法（包括使用更大模型的方法）；整体执行准确率61.06%，Soft F1 68.77%。
AI.conclusion: CA-SQL通过动态搜索广度控制和进化式提示播种，有效提升了LLM在复杂Text-to-SQL任务上的推理能力，验证了推理时计算资源分配的智能策略对性能提升的重要性。

title: InterLV-Search: Benchmarking Interleaved Multimodal Agentic Search
summary: Existing benchmarks for multimodal agentic search evaluate multimodal search and visual browsing, but visual evidence is either confined to the input or treated as an answer endpoint rather than part of an interleaved search trajectory. We introduce \textbf{InterLV-Search}, a benchmark for Interleaved Language-Vision Agentic Search, in which textual and visual evidence is repeatedly used to condition later search. It contains 2,061 examples across three levels: active visual evidence seeking, controlled offline interleaved multimodal search, and open-web interleaved multimodal search. Beyond existing benchmarks, it also includes multimodal multi-branch samples that involve comparison between multiple entities during the evidence search. We construct Level 1 and Level 2 with automated pipelines and Level 3 with a machine-led, human-supervised open-web pipeline. We further provide InterLV-Agent for standardized tool use, trajectory logging, and evaluation. Experiments on proprietary and open-source multimodal agents show that current systems remain far from solving interleaved multimodal search, with the best model below 50% overall accuracy, highlighting challenges in visual evidence seeking, search control, and multimodal evidence integration. We release the benchmark data and evaluation code at https://github.com/hbhalpha/InterLV-Search-Bench

AI.tldr: InterLV-Search是一个用于评估交错语言-视觉智能体搜索的新基准，包含2,061个样本，分三个难度级别。实验表明当前最优模型准确率低于50%，证明交错多模态搜索仍是重大挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有基准中，视觉证据要么仅作为输入、要么作为答案终点，缺乏将视觉和文本证据交错用于后续搜索的评估。作者希望填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建了三级基准：Level 1主动视觉证据寻求、Level 2受控离线交错多模态搜索、Level 3开放网络交错多模态搜索。Level 1/2使用自动化管道构建，Level 3采用机器主导、人工监督的开放网络管道。同时提供InterLV-Agent工具用于标准化评估。
AI.result: 当前最好的多模态智能体在整体准确率上低于50%，表明现有系统远未能解决交错多模态搜索问题。
AI.conclusion: 交错多模态搜索对现有系统仍是重大挑战，特别是在视觉证据寻求、搜索控制和多模态证据整合方面。基准数据和代码已开源。

title: The Memory Curse: How Expanded Recall Erodes Cooperative Intent in LLM Agents
summary: Context window expansion is often treated as a straightforward capability upgrade for LLMs, but we find it systematically fails in multi-agent social dilemmas. Across 7 LLMs and 4 games over 500 rounds, expanding accessible history degrades cooperation in 18 of 28 model--game settings, a pattern we term the memory curse. We isolate the underlying mechanism through three analyses. First, lexical analysis of 378,000 reasoning traces associates this breakdown with eroding forward-looking intent rather than rising paranoia. We validate this using targeted fine-tuning as a cognitive probe: a LoRA adapter trained exclusively on forward-looking traces mitigates the decay and transfers zero-shot to distinct games. Second, memory sanitization holds prompt length fixed while replacing visible history with synthetic cooperative records, which restores cooperation substantially, proving the trigger is memory content, not length alone. Finally, ablating explicit Chain-of-Thought reasoning often reduces the collapse, showing that deliberation paradoxically amplifies the memory curse. Together, these results recast memory as an active determinant of multi-agent behavior: longer recall can either destabilize or support cooperation depending on the reasoning patterns it elicits.

AI.tldr: 论文发现，在LLM多智能体社会困境中，扩展上下文窗口（记忆）反而系统性地破坏合作，称为"记忆诅咒"。通过分析推理痕迹、记忆清洗和思维链消融实验，揭示其机制：记忆诅咒源于前向意图侵蚀而非猜疑上升，内容而非长度是关键，且显式推理会放大该效应。
AI.motivation: 挑战"上下文窗口扩展总是有益的"这一默认假设，揭示在多智能体社会困境中，扩展记忆会系统性地破坏合作行为。
AI.method: 在7个LLM、4种博弈游戏、超过500轮实验中，通过三类分析验证：(1) 对37.8万条推理痕迹进行词汇分析及LoRA微调探测；(2) 记忆清洗实验（用合成合作记录替换可见历史）；(3) 消融显式Chain-of-Thought推理。
AI.result: 28个模型-游戏设置中18个出现合作退化；记忆诅咒源于前向意图的侵蚀；记忆内容而非长度是触发因素；显式CoT推理会放大而非缓解该问题。
AI.conclusion: 记忆是多智能体行为的主动决定因素——更长回忆的效果取决于它引发的推理模式，可能破坏也可能支持合作。

title: Hierarchical Dual-Subspace Decoupling for Continual Learning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Class-incremental learning aims to continuously acquire new knowledge while preserving previously learned information, thereby mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Existing methods primarily restrict parameter updates but often overlook their structural properties in high-dimensional spaces. From a subspace perspective, updates induced by different tasks tend to lie in multiple overlapping low-rank subspaces, leading to cross-task subspace interference and severe forgetting. To address this issue, we propose HDSD, a Hierarchical Dual-Subspace Decoupling framework for continual learning in vision-language models. Specifically, we introduce a lightweight Feature Modulation Module (FMM) that explicitly decomposes the parameter space into general and task-specific subspaces. Building on this design, we develop two complementary components. First, a General Fusion Module (GFM) evaluates relative parameter changes across tasks and uses an adaptive threshold to capture stable and transferable knowledge. Second, a Hierarchical Learning Module (HLM) performs structured parameter decomposition via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and uses a scaling mechanism to constrain updates within distinct subspace scales. Together, these designs reduce subspace interference and parameter drift. Extensive experiments on conventional benchmarks show that HDSD achieves state-of-the-art results.

AI.tldr: 提出HDSD框架，通过层次化双子空间解耦方法解决视觉语言模型中的类增量学习灾难性遗忘问题，在常规基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要限制参数更新，但忽略了参数在高维空间中的结构特性。不同任务产生的更新往往位于多个重叠的低秩子空间中，导致跨任务子空间干扰和严重遗忘。
AI.method: 提出HDSD框架，包含：(1)轻量级特征调制模块(FMM)，将参数空间分解为通用和任务特定子空间；(2)通用融合模块(GFM)，通过自适应阈值捕获稳定可迁移知识；(3)层次化学习模块(HLM)，通过SVD进行结构化参数分解，并用缩放机制约束不同子空间尺度的更新。
AI.result: 在常规基准上的大量实验表明，HDSD达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过层次化双子空间解耦设计，有效减少了子空间干扰和参数漂移，缓解了灾难性遗忘问题。

title: Conformal Path Reasoning: Trustworthy Knowledge Graph Question Answering via Path-Level Calibration
summary: Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA) has shown promise for grounded and interpretable reasoning, yet existing approaches often fail to provide reliable coverage guarantees over retrieved answers. While Conformal Prediction (CP) offers a principled framework for producing prediction sets with statistical guarantees, prior methods suffer from critical limitations in both calibration validity and score discriminability, resulting in violated coverage guarantees and excessively large prediction sets. To address these pitfalls, we propose Conformal Path Reasoning (CPR), a trustworthy KGQA framework with two key innovations. First, we perform query-level conformal calibration over path-level scores, preserving the exchangeability while generating path prediction sets. Second, we introduce the Residual Conformal Value Network (RCVNet), a lightweight module trained via PUCT-guided exploration to learn discriminative path-level nonconformity scores. Experiments on benchmarks show that CPR significantly improves the Empirical Coverage Rate by 34% while reducing average prediction set size by 40% compared to conformal baselines. These results validate the efficacy of CPR in satisfying coverage guarantees with substantially more compact answer sets.

AI.tldr: CPR框架通过查询级共形校准和RCVNet学习判别性路径非一致性分数，在保证统计覆盖的前提下将答案集大小减少40%。
AI.motivation: 现有KGQA方法无法提供可靠的覆盖保证，而传统共形预测方法存在校准有效性和分数可判别性的关键缺陷，导致覆盖保证被违反且预测集过大。
AI.method: 提出CPR框架，包含两项创新：(1) 在路径级别分数上进行查询级共形校准，保持可交换性；(2) 引入RCVNet轻量模块，通过PUCT引导的探索学习判别性路径非一致性分数。
AI.result: 在基准测试中，相比共形基线，经验覆盖率达34%，平均预测集大小减少40%。
AI.conclusion: CPR在满足覆盖保证的同时生成了更紧凑的答案集，验证了其有效性和可靠性。

title: Implicit Preference Alignment for Human Image Animation
summary: Human image animation has witnessed significant advancements, yet generating high-fidelity hand motions remains a persistent challenge due to their high degrees of freedom and motion complexity. While reinforcement learning from human feedback, particularly direct preference optimization, offers a potential solution, it necessitates the construction of strict preference pairs. However, curating such pairs for dynamic hand regions is prohibitively expensive and often impractical due to frame-wise inconsistencies. In this paper, we propose Implicit Preference Alignment (IPA), a data-efficient post-training framework that eliminates the need for paired preference data. Theoretically grounded in implicit reward maximization, IPA aligns the model by maximizing the likelihood of self-generated high-quality samples while penalizing deviations from the pretrained prior. Furthermore, we introduce a Hand-Aware Local Optimization mechanism to explicitly steer the alignment process toward hand regions. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves effective preference optimization to enhance hand generation quality, while significantly lowering the barrier for constructing preference data. Codes are released at https://github.com/mdswyz/IPA

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需配对偏好数据的隐式偏好对齐框架IPA，通过隐式奖励最大化和手部感知局部优化机制，有效提升了手部动作生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的人体图像动画方法在处理手部动作时面临自由度大、复杂度高的挑战。虽然RLHF和DPO等方法有潜力，但构建严格的手部偏好数据对成本过高且不现实。
AI.method: 提出隐式偏好对齐(IPA)框架：基于隐式奖励最大化理论，通过最大化自生成高质量样本的似然并惩罚偏离预训练先验的行为来实现对齐；同时引入手部感知局部优化机制，显式引导对齐过程聚焦于手部区域。
AI.result: 实验表明IPA方法能有效实现偏好优化，显著提升手部生成质量，同时大幅降低了偏好数据构建的门槛。
AI.conclusion: IPA作为一种数据高效的后训练框架，无需配对偏好数据即可有效增强手部生成质量，代码已开源。

title: LLMs Improving LLMs: Agentic Discovery for Test-Time Scaling
summary: Test-time scaling (TTS) has become an effective approach for improving large language model performance by allocating additional computation during inference. However, existing TTS strategies are largely hand-crafted: researchers manually design reasoning patterns and tune heuristics by intuition, leaving much of the computation-allocation space unexplored. We propose an environment-driven framework, AutoTTS, that changes what researchers design: from individual TTS heuristics to environments where TTS strategies can be discovered automatically. The key to AutoTTS lies in environment construction: the discovery environment must make the control space tractable and provide cheap, frequent feedback for TTS search. As a concrete instantiation, we formulate width--depth TTS as controller synthesis over pre-collected reasoning trajectories and probe signals, where controllers decide when to branch, continue, probe, prune, or stop and can be evaluated cheaply without repeated LLM calls. We further introduce beta parameterization to make the search tractable and fine-grained execution trace feedback to improve discovery efficiency by helping the agent diagnose why a TTS program fails. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that the discovered strategies improve the overall accuracy--cost tradeoff over strong manually designed baselines. The discovered strategies generalize to held-out benchmarks and model scales, while the entire discovery costs only $39.9 and 160 minutes. Our data, and code will be open-source at https://github.com/zhengkid/AutoTTS.

AI.tldr: AutoTTS是一个自动化发现测试时缩放策略的框架，通过构建环境让控制器自动学习何时分支、继续、探测、剪枝或停止，在数学推理任务上以极低成本（39.9美元，160分钟）实现了优于手工设计方法的准确率-成本权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有TTS策略依赖研究人员手工设计推理模式和启发式规则，导致大量计算分配空间未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出AutoTTS框架，将TTS策略发现转化为控制器综合问题：基于预收集的推理轨迹和探测信号，控制器决定何时分支、继续、探测、剪枝或停止；引入beta参数化使搜索可控，使用细粒度执行轨迹反馈提升发现效率。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准上，自动发现的策略在准确率-成本权衡上优于强手工设计基线；策略可泛化到未见基准和不同模型规模；整个发现过程仅需39.9美元和160分钟。
AI.conclusion: AutoTTS通过环境驱动的方式实现了TTS策略的自动化发现，改变了研究者从设计具体启发式规则转变为设计发现环境，显著降低了成本并提升了策略性能。

title: Mind the Gap: Geometrically Accurate Generative Reconstruction from Disjoint Views
summary: 3D vision systems are fundamentally constrained by their reliance on visual overlap: reconstruction methods require it for geometric alignment, while generative models use it to enforce multi-view consistency. This limitation is particularly acute in real-world scenarios such as distributed swarm robotics or crowd-sourced data collection, where capturing overlapping perspectives, both in terms of spatial and appearance overlap, is often impossible. We introduce Generative Reconstruction from Disjoint Views as a new paradigm, establish a comprehensive dataset, and propose specialized evaluation metrics for zero-overlap scenarios. Our benchmarking demonstrates that existing state-of-the-art methods fail catastrophically on this task, producing disconnected geometries or semantically incoherent reconstructions. To address these limitations, we propose GLADOS, a general, modular framework that operates through three stages: (1) Generative Bridging, where foundation models synthesize intermediate perspectives to connect disjoint inputs; (2) Robust Coarse 3D Reconstruction, that establish coarse geometric scaffold via global alignment which absorbs local contradictions from generative process; and (3) Iterative Context Expansion and Consistency Optimization to fill missing regions and unify the reconstruction. As an architectureagnostic framework, GLADOS enables seamless integration of future advances in generation, reconstruction, and inpainting. The source code is available at: https://github.com/gwilczynski95/GLADOS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为GLADOS的通用模块化框架，用于解决3D视觉系统中视角不重叠（零重叠场景）下的生成式重建问题。该框架通过生成桥梁、粗粒度3D重建和迭代上下文扩展三个步骤，弥补了现有方法在此任务上的失败。
AI.motivation: 现有3D视觉系统严重依赖视觉重叠（空间和外观重叠），但在分布式集群机器人或众包数据采集等真实场景中，捕捉重叠视角往往不可行。作者旨在解决零重叠视角下的3D重建这一尚未被充分研究的挑战。
AI.method: 提出GLADOS框架，包含三个阶段：(1) 生成桥梁——利用基础模型合成中间视角以连接不连续的输入；(2) 稳健粗粒度3D重建——通过全局对齐建立粗几何骨架，吸收生成过程中的局部矛盾；(3) 迭代上下文扩展与一致性优化——填补缺失区域并统一重建结果。该框架是架构无关的，可无缝集成生成、重建和修复领域的未来进展。
AI.result: 基准测试表明，现有最先进方法在零重叠任务上彻底失败，产生不连续的几何结构或语义不连贯的重建。GLADOS有效解决了这些局限性。
AI.conclusion: GLADOS为不相交视角的生成式重建提供了可行范式，其模块化设计使其具备良好的可扩展性和未来兼容性。

title: VIMCAN: Visual-Inertial 3D Human Pose Estimation with Hybrid Mamba-Cross-Attention Network
summary: The rapid advances in deep learning have significantly enhanced the accuracy of multimodal 3D human pose estimation (HPE). However, the state-of-the-art (SOTA) HPE pipelines still rely on Transformers, whose quadratic complexity makes real-time processing for long sequences impractical. Mamba addresses this issue through selective state-space modeling, enabling efficient sequence processing without sacrificing representational power. Nevertheless, it struggles to capture complex spatial dependencies in multimodal settings. To bridge this gap, we propose VIMCAN, a hybrid architecture that combines the efficient sequence modeling of Mamba with the spatial reasoning of Cross-Attention, and performs robust visual-inertial fusion and human pose estimation between RGB keypoints and wearable IMU data. By leveraging Mamba's dynamic parameterization for temporal modeling and Attention for spatial dependency extraction, VIMCAN achieves superior accuracy, with mean per-joint position errors (MPJPE) of 17.2 mm on TotalCapture and 45.3 mm on 3DPW. VIMCAN outperforms prior Transformer-based and other SOTA approaches while supporting real-time inference at over 60 frames per second on consumer-grade hardware. The source code is available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 提出VIMCAN，一种混合Mamba与Cross-Attention的架构，用于多模态3D人体姿态估计，在保证实时性（>60 FPS）的同时取得了SOTA精度（TotalCapture上MPJPE 17.2mm，3DPW上45.3mm）。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Transformer的SOTA 3D HPE方法在处理长序列时因二次复杂度难以实现实时处理；Mamba虽能高效处理序列但难以捕捉多模态设置下的复杂空间依赖。
AI.method: 提出VIMCAN混合架构：利用Mamba的动态参数化进行时序建模，利用Cross-Attention进行空间依赖提取，实现RGB关键点与穿戴式IMU数据的鲁棒视觉-惯性融合与姿态估计。
AI.result: TotalCapture上MPJPE 17.2mm，3DPW上45.3mm，优于此前基于Transformer及其他SOTA方法，且在消费级硬件上支持>60 FPS的实时推理。
AI.conclusion: VIMCAN通过Mamba与Cross-Attention的混合设计，在精度与实时性之间取得了更好的平衡，为多模态3D HPE提供了一种高效实用的新方案。

title: Dynamic Mode Decomposition along Depth in Vision Transformers
summary: Recent work has shown that contiguous vision transformer (ViT) blocks (a) can be replaced by a linear map and (b) organize into recurrent phases of computation. We ask whether these observations coincide: does ViT depth implement approximately \textit{autonomous linear} dynamics, admitting a single operator $K$ applied recurrently across a contiguous span? We test this using Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD), which fits $K$ from selected, consecutive hidden-state pairs and predicts $p$ steps ahead via $K^p$. On four pretrained DINO ViTs, we study the regularization, rank, and calibration budget required for stable fitting. For short spans ($p \leq 4$), $K^p$ tracks an unconstrained endpoint map to within $0.02$ cosine similarity on DINOv3-H/16+, while also recovering intermediate activations at each skipped block. At early cut starts, the fitted operators compress to rank $\ll d$ with minimal calibration data, and across tokens, \texttt{cls} is most amenable to linearization; both properties decay monotonically with depth. Yet this local fidelity does not transfer downstream. At the final hidden state, after propagating through the remaining blocks, an identity baseline becomes competitive.

AI.tldr: 本文发现Vision Transformer（ViT）的连续块可被近似为循环应用的线性算子，并使用动态模式分解（DMD）验证了这一假设。实验表明，在短跨度（p≤4）内，线性预测能高精度恢复中间激活，但局部线性化效果无法传递到下游任务。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明ViT的连续块可被线性映射替代，且呈现循环计算阶段。作者想探究这两个现象是否对应——即ViT深度是否实现了近似自洽的线性动力学，从而可以用单一算子K循环作用于连续跨度。
AI.method: 采用动态模式分解（DMD）方法，从选定的连续隐藏状态对中拟合线性算子K，并通过K^p向前预测p步。在四个预训练DINO ViT模型上测试，分析正则化、秩和校准预算对稳定拟合的影响。
AI.result: 短跨度（p≤4）时，K^p跟踪无约束端点映射的余弦相似度误差在0.02以内，并能恢复跳过的中间激活。早期切割位置拟合的算子压缩到秩远小于d，且cls token最易线性化，但两者随深度单调衰减。局部线性化效果无法传递到下游，在最终隐藏状态上，恒等基线变得具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: ViT在局部块中确实表现出近似线性动力学，但这一特性具有深度和任务依赖性——局部线性化在高层次不如恒等映射，表明线性近似存在局限。

title: Beyond GSD-as-Token: Continuous Scale Conditioning for Remote Sensing VLMs
summary: Remote sensing vision-language models (RS-VLMs) face a fundamental mismatch with natural-image counterparts: the same geographic object exhibits radically different visual evidence across ground sampling distances (GSDs) spanning multiple orders of magnitude. Yet existing RS-VLMs often discard GSD or inject it as a discrete text token, forcing a single static parameter set to absorb the entire scale spectrum. We introduce ScaleEarth, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning framework built on Qwen3-VL that treats GSD as a continuous conditioning variable governing the model's computation path. At its core, CS-HLoRA (Continuous Scale-Conditioned Hyper-LoRA) modulates the LoRA low-rank subspace through a GSD-driven gate, enabling the model to dynamically route computation by physical scale. To remove reliance on sensor metadata at deployment, we pair CS-HLoRA with SSE-U, a lightweight heteroscedastic sub-head that predicts GSD and its uncertainty from visual features. To provide matching supervision, we construct GeoScale-VQA, a 1.5M-sample scale-layered RS-VQA corpus whose question-answer generation is conditioned on the same physical scalar that drives CS-HLoRA, forming a closed method-data loop. Trained with QLoRA on an 8B backbone, ScaleEarth achieves state-of-the-art results on remote-sensing benchmarks covering diverse Earth-system tasks, including XLRS-Bench and OmniEarth-Bench.

AI.tldr: ScaleEarth 是一个针对遥感视觉语言模型的参数高效微调框架，通过连续地面采样距离（GSD）条件控制模型计算路径，实现了跨尺度遥感图像理解的最新性能。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感视觉语言模型存在根本性缺陷：同一地理对象在不同地面采样距离（GSD）下呈现截然不同的视觉特征，但现有方法要么丢弃GSD信息，要么将其作为离散文本标记注入，迫使单一静态参数集适应整个尺度谱系。
AI.method: 提出CS-HLoRA（连续尺度条件超LoRA）机制，通过GSD驱动的门控调节LoRA低秩子空间，实现模型计算路径的动态路由；搭配SSE-U轻量异方差子头从视觉特征预测GSD及其不确定性；构建GeoScale-VQA数据集形成闭环方法-数据循环，使用QLoRA在8B骨干网络上训练。
AI.result: 在涵盖多种地球系统任务的遥感基准测试（如XLRS-Bench和OmniEarth-Bench）上取得了最新最优结果。
AI.conclusion: 将GSD作为连续条件变量而非离散或忽略的特征，能显著提升遥感VLM的跨尺度理解能力，CS-HLoRA框架验证了物理尺度条件化在遥感基础模型中的有效性。

title: Tracing the Arrow of Time: Diagnosing Temporal Information Flow in Video-LLMs
summary: The Arrow-of-Time (AoT) task, determining whether a video plays forward or backward by recognizing temporal irreversibility, is one humans solve with near-perfect accuracy, yet frontier Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) perform only modestly above chance. This gap raises a key question: do visual backbones fail to encode temporal information, or does information bottleneck lie elsewhere in the Video-LLM architecture? We address this question by isolating the vision encoder from the Video-LLM and tracing temporal information across the encoder, projector, and LLM. We find that video-centric encoders with explicit temporal modeling encode strong temporal signals, whereas frame-centric encoders do not. However, when video-centric representations are passed through a standard Video-LLM architecture, performance often collapses, revealing a bottleneck of temporal information flow. We identify projector design as a key factor: Q-Former disrupts temporal information, while a time-preserved MLP projection substantially improves the LLM's access to such information. Our layer-wise analysis further shows temporal representation dynamics across encoder layers. Guided by these findings, we build a Video-LLM with temporal-aware video-centric encoder, time-preserved projector, and AoT supervision, surpassing human performance on AoT$_{PPB}$ with 98.1\% accuracy, and improving broader temporal reasoning tasks by up to 6.0 points on VITATECS-Direction and 1.3 points on TVBench. Our results show that temporal reasoning in Video-LLMs requires both effective temporal encoding and reliable transfer of this information to the LLM.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了时间箭头（AoT）任务中Video-LLM性能不佳的原因，发现视觉编码器本身能编码时间信息，但在通过Q-Former投影器时信息丢失严重；通过使用时间感知的视频编码器、保留时间的MLP投影器和AoT监督，构建的模型在AoT_PPB任务上超越人类表现（98.1%），并在其他时间推理任务上提升显著。
AI.motivation: 人类在判断视频时间方向（正放/倒放）上近乎完美，而前沿Video-LLM仅略高于随机水平。作者想探究这一差距的根本原因：是视觉编码器无法编码时间信息，还是信息瓶颈存在于Video-LLM架构的其他部分。
AI.method: 将视觉编码器从Video-LLM中隔离出来，分别追踪时间信息在编码器、投影器和LLM中的流动。通过对比实验发现Q-Former破坏时间信息，而MLP投影器能保留时间信息。基于此构建了包含时间感知视频编码器、时间保留投影器和AoT监督的Video-LLM。
AI.result: 在AoT_PPB任务上达到98.1%准确率，超越人类表现；在VITATECS-Direction上提升6.0个点，在TVBench上提升1.3个点。
AI.conclusion: Video-LLM中的时间推理既需要有效的时间编码，也需要将这些信息可靠地传递到LLM中。投影器设计是时间信息流的关键瓶颈。

title: PolarVLM: Bridging the Semantic-Physical Gap in Vision-Language Models
summary: Mainstream vision-language models (VLMs) fundamentally struggle with severe optical ambiguities, such as reflections and transparent objects, due to the inherent limitations of standard RGB inputs. While polarization imaging captures polarimetric physical parameters that resolve these ambiguities, existing methods are constrained by fixed-format outputs and remain isolated from open-ended reasoning. To bridge this semantic-physical gap, we introduce PolarVLM, the first multimodal framework integrating polarimetric physical parameters into VLMs. By employing a dual-stream architecture and a progressive two-stage training strategy, PolarVLM effectively prevents physical misinterpretations while preserving general visual abilities. Complementing our architecture, we construct PolarVQA, the first benchmark for polarization-aware VQA, featuring 75K physics-grounded instruction-tuning pairs targeting reflective and transparent scenes. Experiments show that PolarVLM surpasses the RGB baseline by 25.4% overall across five evaluation tasks, with remarkable gains of 26.6% in reflection recognition and 34.0% in glass counting, successfully unlocking physics-aware semantic understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出PolarVLM，首个将偏振物理参数融入视觉语言模型的框架，通过双流架构和两阶段训练策略，结合偏振VQA基准数据集，在反射和透明场景中显著超越RGB基线模型。
AI.motivation: 主流VLM在反射、透明物体等光学模糊场景中表现不佳，而偏振成像虽能解决该问题但缺乏与开放推理的结合，因此需要弥合语义-物理鸿沟。
AI.method: 采用双流架构（偏振物理参数流+视觉语言流）和渐进式两阶段训练策略，构建包含7.5万条物理引导指令微调对的PolarVQA基准。
AI.result: 五个评估任务中总体超越RGB基线25.4%，反射识别提升26.6%，玻璃计数提升34.0%。
AI.conclusion: 成功解锁了物理感知的语义理解能力，为VLM处理光学模糊场景提供了有效方案。

title: Response-G1: Explicit Scene Graph Modeling for Proactive Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Proactive streaming video understanding requires Video-LLMs to decide when to respond as a video unfolds, a task where existing methods often fall short due to their implicit, query-agnostic modeling of visual evidence. We introduce Response-G1, a novel framework that establishes explicit, structured alignment between the accumulated video evidence and the query's expected response conditions via scene graphs. The framework operates in three fine-tuning-free stages: (1) online query-guided scene graph generation from streaming clips; (2) memory-based retrieval of the most semantically relevant historical scene graphs; and (3) retrieval-augmented trigger prompting for per-frame "silence/response" decisions.By grounding both evidence and conditions in a shared graph representation, Response-G1 achieves more interpretable and accurate response timing decisions. Experimental results on established benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of our method in both proactive and reactive tasks, validating the advantage of explicit scene graph modeling and retrieval in streaming video understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出Response-G1框架，通过场景图建立视频证据与查询响应条件之间的显式对齐，在流式视频理解中实现更准确的可解释响应时机决策。
AI.motivation: 现有Video-LLMs在流式视频理解中隐式且与查询无关地建模视觉证据，无法有效判断何时响应。
AI.method: 三个免微调阶段：(1)在线查询引导的场景图生成；(2)基于记忆检索最相关历史场景图；(3)检索增强的触发提示用于逐帧静音/响应决策。
AI.result: 在既有基准上，在主动和被动任务中均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式的场景图建模与检索在流式视频理解中具有优势，能提升响应时机的可解释性和准确性。

title: TraceAV-Bench: Benchmarking Multi-Hop Trajectory Reasoning over Long Audio-Visual Videos
summary: Real-world audio-visual understanding requires chaining evidence that is sparse, temporally dispersed, and split across the visual and auditory streams, whereas existing benchmarks largely fail to evaluate this capability. They restrict videos to short clips, isolate modalities, or reduce questions to one-hop perception. We introduce TraceAV-Bench, the first benchmark to jointly evaluate multi-hop reasoning over long audio-visual trajectories and multimodal hallucination robustness. TraceAV-Bench comprises 2,200 rigorously validated multiple-choice questions over 578 long videos, totaling 339.5 hours, spanning 4 evaluation dimensions and 15 sub-tasks. Each question is grounded in an explicit reasoning chain that averages 3.68 hops across a 15.1-minute temporal span. The dataset is built by a three-step semi-automated pipeline followed by a strict quality assurance process. Evaluation of multiple representative OmniLLMs on TraceAV-Bench reveals that the benchmark poses a persistent challenge across all models, with the strongest closed-source model (Gemini 3.1 Pro) reaching only 68.29% on general tasks, and the best open-source model (Ming-Flash-Omni-2.0) reaching 51.70%, leaving substantial headroom. Moreover, we find that robustness to multimodal hallucination is largely decoupled from general multimodal reasoning performance. We anticipate that TraceAV-Bench will stimulate further research toward OmniLLMs that can reason coherently and faithfully over long-form audio-visual content.

AI.tldr: TraceAV-Bench是首个联合评估长视频多跳推理和多模态幻觉鲁棒性的基准，包含2,200道题、578个长视频（共339.5小时），平均推理链3.68跳、时间跨度15.1分钟。最强闭源模型（Gemini 3.1 Pro）仅达68.29%，最佳开源模型（Ming-Flash-Omni-2.0）达51.70%，表明该基准具有较大挑战性。
AI.motivation: 现有基准局限于短视频片段、隔离模态或仅考察单跳感知，无法评估真实世界中对稀疏分散于视听双流证据的链式推理能力，因此亟需一个能同时评估长视频多跳推理和幻觉鲁棒性的基准。
AI.method: 通过三步半自动化流水线构建数据集，包含2,200道经严格质量保证的多选题，覆盖578个长视频（共339.5小时），跨越4个评估维度和15个子任务，平均推理链3.68跳、时间跨度15.1分钟。
AI.result: 强闭源模型Gemini 3.1 Pro在通用任务上仅达68.29%，最佳开源模型Ming-Flash-Omni-2.0达51.70%；多模态幻觉鲁棒性与通用多模态推理性能基本解耦。
AI.conclusion: TraceAV-Bench对现有OmniLLMs构成持续挑战，存在较大提升空间，有望推动能够在长视听内容上连贯且忠实推理的模型研究。

title: GazeVLM: Active Vision via Internal Attention Control for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Human visual reasoning is governed by active vision, a process where metacognitive control drives top-down goal-directed attention, dynamically routing foveal focus toward task-relevant details while maintaining peripheral awareness of the global scene. In contrast, modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) process visual information passively, relying on the static accumulation of massive token contexts that dilute spatial reasoning and induce linguistic hallucinations. Here we propose the following paradigm shift: GazeVLM, a multimodal architecture that internalizes this metacognitive oversight over its deployment of attention resources directly into the reasoning loop. By empowering the VLM to autonomously generate gaze tokens ($\texttt{<LOOK>}$), GazeVLM establishes a top-down control mechanism over its own causal attention mask. The model dynamically dictates its focal intent, triggering a continuous suppression bias that dampens irrelevant visual features, implementing spatial selective attention and simulating foveal fixation. Once local reasoning concludes, the bias lifts, seamlessly restoring the global view. This architecture enables the model to fluidly transition between global spatial awareness and localized focal reasoning without relying on external agentic contraptions like cropping tools, or inflating the context window with additional visual tokens derived from localized visual patches. Trained with a bespoke Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) procedure that rewards valid grounding, our 4B-parameter GazeVLM delivers strong high-resolution multimodal reasoning performance, surpassing state-of-the-art VLMs in its parameter class by nearly 4% and agentic multimodal pipelines built around thinking with images by more than 5% on HRBench-4k and HRBench-8k.

AI.tldr: GazeVLM是一种将元认知注意力控制内化到推理循环中的多模态架构，通过自生成凝视令牌（<LOOK>）实现自上而下的注意力机制，在无需外部裁剪工具或增加上下文窗口的情况下，动态切换全局感知与局部聚焦推理，在4B参数规模上超越了同类VLM和智能体管道。
AI.motivation: 当前VLM被动处理视觉信息，依赖静态积累的大量令牌上下文，这稀释了空间推理能力并诱发语言幻觉，缺乏类似人类主动视觉中的元认知注意力控制机制。
AI.method: GazeVLM让VLM自主生成凝视令牌（<LOOK>）建立对自身因果注意力掩码的自上而下控制，通过持续抑制偏置衰减无关视觉特征（模拟空间选择性注意与中央凹注视），局部推理结束后解除偏置恢复全局视图。采用专门设计的GRPO训练流程奖励有效接地。
AI.result: 4B参数的GazeVLM在HRBench-4k和HRBench-8k上超越同类SOTA VLM近4%，超越基于智能体的多模态管道超过5%。
AI.conclusion: 将元认知注意力控制直接内化到VLM推理循环中，可以有效提升高分辨率多模态推理性能，无需依赖外部工具或增加视觉令牌数量。

title: SAM 3D Animal: Promptable Animal 3D Reconstruction from Images in the Wild
summary: 3D animal reconstruction in the wild remains challenging due to large species variation, frequent occlusions, and the prevalence of multi-animal scenes, while existing methods predominantly focus on single-animal settings. We present SAM 3D Animal, the first promptable framework for multi-animal 3D reconstruction from a single image. Built on the SMAL+ parametric animal model, our method jointly reconstructs multiple instances and supports flexible prompts in the form of keypoints and masks which enable more reliable disambiguation in crowded and occluded scenes. To train such a model, we further introduce Herd3D, a multi-animal 3D dataset containing over 5K images, designed to increase diversity in species, interactions, and occlusion patterns. Experiments on the Animal3D, APTv2, and Animal Kingdom datasets show that our framework achieves state-of-the-art results over both existing model-based and model-free methods, demonstrating a scalable and effective solution for prompt-driven animal 3D reconstruction in the wild.

AI.tldr: 提出了SAM 3D Animal，首个支持提示驱动的多动物3D重建框架，并构建了Herd3D多动物3D数据集，在多个基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 野外3D动物重建面临物种多样、频繁遮挡和多动物场景的挑战，现有方法主要针对单动物场景，缺乏处理多动物重建的有效方案。
AI.method: 基于SMAL+参数化动物模型，提出SAM 3D Animal框架，支持关键点和掩码形式的灵活提示，联合重建多个实例；同时构建Herd3D多动物3D数据集（5000+图像）用于训练。
AI.result: 在Animal3D、APTv2和Animal Kingdom数据集上，超越现有基于模型和无模型的方法，达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 提出的方法为提示驱动的野外动物3D重建提供了可扩展且有效的解决方案。

title: LithoBench: Benchmarking Large Multimodal Models for Remote-Sensing Lithology Interpretation
summary: Remote sensing lithology interpretation is fundamental to geological surveys, mineral exploration, and regional geological mapping. Unlike general land-cover recognition, lithology interpretation is a knowledge-intensive task that requires experts to infer rock types from various features, e.g., subtle visual, spectral, textural, geomorphological, and contextual cues, making reliable automated interpretation highly challenging. Geological knowledge-guided large multimodal models offer new opportunities, yet their evaluation remains constrained by the lack of benchmarks that capture lithological annotations, multi-level geological semantics, and expert-informed assessment. Here, we propose LithoBench, a multi-level benchmark for evaluating geological semantic understanding in remote sensing lithology interpretation. LithoBench contains 10,000 expert-annotated interpretation instances across 12 representative lithological categories, including 4,000 multiple-choice and 6,000 open-ended tasks organized into five cognitive levels: Identification and Description, Comparative Analysis, Mechanism Explanation, Practical Application, and Comprehensive Reasoning. We further develop an expert-in-the-loop, knowledge-grounded semi-automated construction pipeline, coupling multi sub-processes, e.g., structured geological image descriptions, to enhance geological validity and evaluation reliability. Experiments with multiple large vision-language models eveal substantial limitations in geological semantic understanding, particularly on higher-order explanation, application, and reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出了LithoBench，一个包含10,000个专家标注实例、12个岩性类别、覆盖5个认知层次（从识别到综合推理）的多层次遥感岩性解译基准，实验表明大模型在地质语义理解方面存在显著局限。
AI.motivation: 遥感岩性解译是知识密集型任务，现有大模型评估缺乏包含岩性标注、多层次地质语义和专家评估的基准。
AI.method: 构建包含10,000个专家标注实例（4,000道选择题+6,000道开放题）、12个岩性类别、5个认知层次的基准，并设计了专家参与、知识引导的半自动化构建流程。
AI.result: 在多个大视觉-语言模型上的实验表明，模型在地质语义理解方面存在显著不足，尤其是在高层次的解释、应用和推理任务上。
AI.conclusion: LithoBench可作为评估遥感岩性解译中地质语义理解的有效基准，揭示了现有模型在高阶认知任务上的局限性。

title: EggHand: A Multimodal Foundation Model for Egocentric Hand Pose Forecasting
summary: Forecasting future 3D hand pose sequences from egocentric video is essential for understanding human intention and enabling embodied applications such as AR/VR assistance and human-robot interaction. However, this task remains a highly challenging problem because egocentric hand motion is driven by complex human intent, exhibits highly dexterous articulations, and is observed under drastic viewpoint shifts induced by ego-motion. In this work, we introduce EggHand, a foundation-model-based framework for egocentric hand pose forecasting that unifies multimodal semantic reasoning with dynamic motion modeling. Our approach couples an action decoder from a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model, which captures the structured temporal dynamics of hand motion, with an egocentric video-text encoder that provides viewpoint-aware contextual information learned from large-scale first-person video. Together, these components overcome the brittleness of generic visual encoders under ego-motion and enable joint reasoning over motion, context, and high-level intent-without relying on body pose or external tracking. Experiments on the EgoExo4D dataset show that EggHand sets a new state of the art in forecasting accuracy, remains robust under severe ego-motion, and further enables controllable prediction via language-based task prompts. Project page: https://jyoun9.github.io/EggHand

AI.tldr: 本文提出EggHand框架，基于基础模型实现从第一人称视频预测未来3D手部姿态序列，通过结合视觉-语言-动作模型与第一人称视频文本编码器，在EgoExo4D数据集上达到最先进水平。
AI.motivation: 第一人称视频中的手部运动由复杂的人类意图驱动，具有高度灵巧的关节运动，且受自我运动导致的视角剧烈变化影响，现有方法难以准确预测未来手部姿态序列。
AI.method: 将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的动作解码器与第一人称视频文本编码器相结合，动作解码器捕捉手部运动的时序动态，编码器提供视角感知的上下文信息，无需依赖身体姿态或外部追踪。
AI.result: 在EgoExo4D数据集上，EggHand在预测精度上达到新的最优水平，在剧烈自我运动下保持鲁棒性，并支持基于语言任务提示的可控预测。
AI.conclusion: EggHand有效统一了多模态语义推理与动态运动建模，为理解人类意图和AR/VR等具身应用提供了可行方案。

title: Operating Within the Operational Design Domain: Zero-Shot Perception with Vision-Language Models
summary: Over the last few years, research on autonomous systems has matured to such a degree that the field is increasingly well-positioned to translate research into practical, stakeholder-driven use cases across well-defined domains. However, for a wide-scale practical adoption of autonomous systems, adherence to safety regulations is crucial. Many regulations are influenced by the Operational Design Domain (ODD), which defines the specific conditions in which an autonomous agent can function. This is especially relevant for Automated Driving Systems (ADS), as a dependable perception of ODD elements is essential for safe implementation and auditing. Vision-language models (VLMs) integrate visual recognition and language reasoning, functioning without task-specific training data, which makes them suitable for adaptable ODD perception. To assess whether VLMs can function as zero-shot "ODD sensors" that adapt to evolving definitions, we contribute (i) an empirical study of zero-shot ODD classification and detection using four VLMs on a custom dataset and Mapillary Vistas, along with failure analyses; (ii) an ablation of zero-shot optimization strategies with a cost-performance overview; and (iii) a suite of reusable prompting templates with guidance for adaptation. Our findings indicate that definition-anchored chain-of-thought prompting with persona decomposition performs best, while other methods may result in reduced recall. Overall, our results pave the way for transparent and effective ODD-based perception in safety-critical applications.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了视觉-语言模型（VLMs）作为零样本“ODD传感器”的可行性，用于自动化驾驶系统的运行设计域（ODD）感知。实验表明，定义锚定的思维链提示结合角色分解效果最佳，为安全关键应用中的ODD感知提供了有效路径。
AI.motivation: 随着自主系统走向实际应用，遵守安全法规至关重要，而ODD定义了自主代理的运行条件。对于自动驾驶系统，可靠感知ODD元素是安全实现和审计的关键。VLMs具备视觉识别与语言推理能力，无需任务特定训练数据，因此研究其作为零样本ODD传感器的潜力具有重要价值。
AI.method: 在自定义数据集和Mapillary Vistas上，使用四种VLMs进行零样本ODD分类与检测的实证研究，包括失败分析；对零样本优化策略进行消融实验并给出成本-性能概览；开发了一套可复用的提示模板及适配指南。
AI.result: 定义锚定的思维链提示结合角色分解策略表现最佳，而其他方法可能导致召回率下降。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为安全关键应用中基于ODD的透明、高效感知铺平了道路。

title: Breaking Spatial Uniformity: Prior-Guided Mamba with Radial Serialization for Lens Flare Removal
summary: Lens flares, caused by complex optical aberrations, severely degrade image quality especially in nighttime photography. Although recent restoration methods have made remarkable progress, most still rely on spatially uniform processing. They are failing to handle the region-dependent restoration demands of flare scenes, where saturated light sources should be preserved, flare artifacts removed, and background details recovered. To address this challenge, we propose DeflareMambav2, a prior-guided Mamba framework for lens flare removal. Specifically, we introduce a Flare Prior Network (FPN) to estimate flare priors and guide adaptive restoration. Besides, a novel radial serialization strategy breaks spatially homogeneous processing by performing flare-aware targeted sampling, and better supports long-range modeling in State Space Models (SSMs). Based on these priors, the backbone adopts a dual-level adaptive scheme. It explicitly preserves light-source regions to avoid over-processing, and applies curriculum-based restoration to the remaining contaminated areas while calibrating restoration intensity at the pixel level. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DeflareMambav2 achieves state-of-the-art performance with reduced parameter burden. Code is available at https://github.com/BNU-ERC-ITEA/DeflareMambav2.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeflareMambav2，一种基于先验引导的Mamba框架，用于处理非均匀的镜头眩光去除任务，通过径向序列化策略和双层级自适应恢复方案，在减少参数的同时实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有镜头眩光去除方法大多采用空间均匀处理，无法应对眩光场景中不同区域（饱和光源需保留、眩光伪影需去除、背景细节需恢复）的差异化恢复需求。
AI.method: 提出Flare Prior Network（FPN）估计眩光先验；设计径向序列化策略实现眩光感知的针对性采样；采用双层级自适应方案，显式保留光源区域并对污染区域进行基于课程学习的逐像素恢复。
AI.result: 在减少参数负担的同时，实现了最先进的镜头眩光去除性能。
AI.conclusion: DeflareMambav2通过先验引导和自适应处理，有效解决了非均匀眩光去除问题，代码已开源。

title: Aquatic Neuromorphic Optical Flow
summary: Underwater environments impose severe constraints on conventional imaging systems and demand solutions that balance high-quality sensing with strict resource efficiency. While emerging event cameras offer a promising alternative, their potential in aquatic scenarios remains largely unexplored. Through the lens of neuromorphic vision, this work pioneers the investigation of motion fields that serve as key media for agile underwater perception. Built upon spiking neural networks, we introduce a self-supervised framework to estimate per-pixel optical flow from asynchronous event streams, elegantly bypassing the long-standing bottleneck of underwater data scarcity. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our method achieves competitive visual and quantitative results against leading techniques while operating with superior computational efficiency. By bridging neuromorphic sensing and aquatic intelligence, this work opens new frontiers for lightweight, real-time, and low-cost perception on resource-constrained underwater edge platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于脉冲神经网络的自监督框架，从异步事件流中估计逐像素光流，实现了在资源受限的水下边缘平台上高效、轻量级的实时感知。
AI.motivation: 水下环境对传统成像系统限制极大，需要兼顾高质量感知与严格的资源效率。事件相机虽有潜力，但在水下场景的探索尚处空白，且水下数据标注稀缺是长期瓶颈。
AI.method: 基于神经形态视觉，利用脉冲神经网络（SNN）构建自监督框架，从异步事件流中估计逐像素光流，无需标注数据。
AI.result: 与主流技术相比，该方法在视觉和定量结果上具有竞争力，同时计算效率更高。
AI.conclusion: 该工作连接了神经形态感知与水下智能，为资源受限的水下边缘平台上的轻量级、实时、低成本感知开辟了新方向。

title: Towards Billion-scale Multi-modal Biometric Search
summary: Searching a multi-biometric database of a billion records for a country-level identity system requires pushing the limits of all aspects of a biometric system, including acquisition, preprocessing, feature extraction, accuracy, matching speed, presentation attack detection, and handling of special cases (e.g., missing finger digits). This is the first paper that gives insights into such a large-scale multimodal biometric search system, called Bharat ABIS, based on open-source architectures. The end-to-end pipeline of Bharat ABIS processes fingerprint, face and iris modalities through modality-specific stages of preprocessing (segmentation), quality assessment, presentation attack detection, and learning an embedding (feature extraction), producing a concatenated template of 13.5KB per person. We present a detailed analysis of the modalities and how they are integrated to create an efficient and effective solution for 1:N search (de-duplication).
